issues.title: [Suggestion] Give a setting to disable replacing items on hotbar or at least to not take priority over typing in the search bar
issues.body:
Hello,
I regularly struggle with the issue of randomly replacing items in my hotbar with random junk when in cheat mode. This occurs because pressing shift+number, results in the slot of that number being replaced with the item that you hover over in the JEI. This is problematic due to the fact that "shift+2" is the combination required to type "@" into the search bar. This is especially annoying considering that the aforementioned combination has the priority over the search bar box. 
As such even if the search bar is active and you are in the middle of typing and you press the aforementioned combination, the item in slot 2 gets replaced by whatever my mouse happens to hover over, while deactivating the typing in search bar. I regularly use the "@mod" functionality whereas I've never needed the extra convenience from the faster replacing items in my hot bar.
This functionality has resulted in countless times where I've lost important items as I was not aware that it even existed. For a long time I thought that some unidentifiable mod is simply eating my items and replacing them with random junk.

To summarize I would like to suggest that:
1. For the typing in the search bar, to take priority over the "shift+number" shortcuts as the characters accessed via typing "shift+number" are often necessary for the use of the search bar.
2. For there to be a setting to disable these shortcuts, as from what I have seen they are absent from the controls menu in Minecraft and I could not find them in the config files.

issues.title: suggestion: astral sorcery info tab
issues.body:
astral sorcery info tab::
an entry from the luminous crafting table of the astral tome:

 "place a crafting table in a larger shrine found on surface in overworld (zone 0) then make sure the tutorial shrine has enough starlight reaching it to activate it (you may need to excavate a large amount of the storm roof to allow productive STAR luminance."
 
in order for the Luminous Crafting Table to work it must be placed somewhere open to the sky, preferably at night for the correct intensity of star energy. This table has a “Star Light” meter at the bottom when you open it. This will fill up depending on where the table is placed and the time. In the middle of the night, your table will have higher levels of Star Light than during the day. Tables placed at a higher elevation (max Y-level 120) will also get more Star Light. Higher levels can be achieved if you are near a Collector Crystal or in an area of high Starlight concentration (more on this later). This Star Light level is also affected by where the moon is and where you are in world, as it depends on what Constellations the table can see. During the day you will get next to no Star Light.

issues.body:
VERSION jei-1.16.5:7.7.1.121
Minecraft 1.16.5
Forge 36.2.2

Note: Maybe i am using isHandled wrong. My goal is to have only a custom subset of crafting recipes handled and showing up in the "recipe list"  .  For example, if i wanted every recipe where at least one ingredient is a stick or something.  Custom logic to filter.  isHandled is the closest i could find

This method in the interface says 
```	/**
	 * @return true if the given recipe can be handled by this category.
	 * @since JEI 7.2.0
	 */
	default boolean isHandled(T recipe) {
```
	
Im working on a machine that only works on a subset of vanilla recipes (kind of like anything shapeless where all ingredients match each other)

However, in my category when i code it like this

```	
  @Override
  public boolean isHandled(ICraftingRecipe recipe) {
    System.out.println(recipe.getId() + " ISHANDLED!!");
    return false;
}
```	

The println is never seen in the log, breakpoints are not hit. and every crafting recipe still comes up as 'handled' and is linked to the block 

Source : https://github.com/Lothrazar/Cyclic/blob/465bfe8dd85df750782bdf21305478d03b09e0b8/src/main/java/com/lothrazar/cyclic/compat/jei/PackagerRecipeCategory.java#L61

issues.title: Switching filter text field in item overlay focused an unfocused makes repeated keyboard event in GUI invalid
issues.body:
Here is an easy way to produce the issue:

1. Open creative inventory
2. Focus on the filter text field
3. Click the search text field in creative inventory
4. Type something
5. Keep backspace pressed
6. Only one character get deleted

After following the execusion of code for a while, I found something might be the reason:

When clicking the text field, it first calls this function to set it focused, without calling `GuiTextFieldFilter.setFocused`:

```
setFocused:238, Widget (net.minecraft.client.gui.widget)
setFocused2:417, TextFieldWidget (net.minecraft.client.gui.widget)
mouseClicked:395, TextFieldWidget (net.minecraft.client.gui.widget)
access$201:25, GuiTextFieldFilter (mezz.jei.input)
handleClick:190, GuiTextFieldFilter$MouseHandler (mezz.jei.input)
handleSearchClick:264, IngredientListOverlay (mezz.jei.gui.overlay)
handleMouseClickedInternal:251, IngredientListOverlay (mezz.jei.gui.overlay)
access$100:38, IngredientListOverlay (mezz.jei.gui.overlay)
handleClick:439, IngredientListOverlay$MouseHandler (mezz.jei.gui.overlay)
handleClick:49, CombinedMouseHandler (mezz.jei.input)
onGuiMouseEvent:153, InputHandler (mezz.jei.input)
... ...
```

Afterwards, it calls  `GuiTextFieldFilter.setFocused`, where `previousKeyboardRepeatEnabled` flag should be acquired and set. But at this moment, `TextFieldWidget.focused` flag is already set, so this step to `previousKeyboardRepeatEnabled` is skipped, leaving the value unchanged and usually false. Here is the stacktrace:

```
setFocused:123, GuiTextFieldFilter (mezz.jei.input)
setKeyboardFocus:326, IngredientListOverlay (mezz.jei.gui.overlay)
access$200:38, IngredientListOverlay (mezz.jei.gui.overlay)
handleClick:441, IngredientListOverlay$MouseHandler (mezz.jei.gui.overlay)
handleClick:49, CombinedMouseHandler (mezz.jei.input)
onGuiMouseEvent:153, InputHandler (mezz.jei.input)
... ...
```

When the search text field loses focus, it will set `keyboardListener.repeatEventsEnabled` flag back to false, making repeated keyboard event in GUI not received.

issues.title: [Issue] JEI Cheat Mod number keyboard shortcuts do not account for modifier key(s) being held
issues.body:
**Issue:**

While in Cheat Mode, JEI treats pressing 1 - 9 the same regardless of whether or not any modifier keys (eg: shift, ctrl, alt) are being held. Pressing keys 1 - 9, modifier key held or not, you will be given a stack of any item hovered in JEI in the associated slot in your hotbar. 

As searching JEI by ModName, Tooltip, Tag, CreativeTab, Color, or Resource ID require entering a special character utilizing the "shift" key modifier followed by the same keys used as shortcuts to obtain a stack into a hotbar slot, it is easy to unintentionally "overwrite" items in your hotbar slot when attempting to search with the search bar unintentionally not selected.


**Request:**

Only allow JEI "Cheat Mode" to place a stack of items into your hotbar if a number key is pressed _without_ any modifier keys held.

**Thank you for your consideration. Be well!**
\- S.

issues.title: [Suggestion] Render "Hide Mode" hidden items as overlay and/or toggle tooltip text
issues.body:
**Issue:**

When in JEI's "Hide Mode" and toggling an item's visibility by clicking on it in, its hidden status is displayed as a red background.

This approach usually works great, but becomes unclear when toggling the visibility of items with icons that take up the full width of the item slot. For example, this is a frequent issue with various liquids added by mods. If the liquid is completely opaque, it is impossible to tell whether or not the item has been selected to be hidden.

**Request:**

Add/change indications that an item has been hidden that will be visible even for items that take up the full width of an item slot.

One approach could be to change the "CTRL-Click to Hide" and "CTRL-right-click to Hide by Wildcard" tooltip text to "Ctrl-Click to Show" and "CTRL-right-click to Show by Wildcard" when the item is already set to be hidden.

Another approach might be to render a tinted overlay over the item icon instead of changing the background behind it.

**Thank you for your consideration. Be well!**
\- S.

issues.title: Unreasonably high memory allocation by RecipeManager
issues.body:
**Description**
In extra large modpacks, RecipeManager is allocating massive amounts of memory.
Please see the screenshots below of the heap dump for reference, RecipeManager is taking ~ 882 MB of memory.

**Question**
I saw in the source code that there have been relatively recent changes of separating RecipeManager from RecipeManagerInternal, so are there any plans of taking the RecipeManagerInternal's caching away from memory and persisting it to disk? Such that it reduces the memory consumption significantly? 
If not, I would like to request the permission for one of the following

- Create a PR for user configurable alternative RecipeManager which caches to disk, invalidates caches on game startup  and only loads selective recipe maps into memory when needed. Its response time will be obviously slightly slower but it will be significantly more memory efficient.
**OR**
- An Addon for JEI to do the same if you think such a feature will not fit within JEI

Thank you

**Screenshots of Heap Dump**

issues.title: Cycle behaviour on scrolling improvement
issues.body:
It would be really nice if the cycling behaviour when scrolling with the mouse wheel could be improved a little.
I am a fan of the feature but what I am suggesting is a hybrid of the current functionality.

Current behaviour:
If you have multiple pages of recipes, you can scroll to cycle through the different pages.
But if you only have one page with a recipe that uses an item tag, the scrolling will cycle through the possible input items.
The issue here is that if you have multiple recipe pages which multiple recipes that have input tags, the cycling through the different input items does not work anymore because it will scroll to the next recipe page instead.
![](https://i.imgur.com/CjAOX2l.gif)

Suggested behaviour:
I think it would be nice to have an option to cycle through both of them.
This could be achieved by a hotkey you have to press.
Let's say if you just scroll without any hotkey, it will cycle through the recipe pages and if you press shift (as an example) while scrolling, it will cycle through the possible ingredients for the recipe on the current page.
This could be further improved by only cycling through the ingredients of the recipe the mouse is currently hovering over. Otherwise it would have to cycle through the ingredients of all the recipes on the current page in case there are more than just one.

As an alternative, you could completely work around the hotkey mechanism.
This would mean that pages are cycling while you are scrolling anywhere and recipe ingredients would cycle while hovering over the slot or the whole recipe.

issues.title: [1.16.5] Is there a way to delay the JEI reload?
issues.body:
Hey I remember mezz saying that there will be a API to delay recipe reloading because it reloads WAY to early.

Why does it reload to early: It reloads after tags were synchronized leaving no room for custom synchronized plugins to send their data.

My current fix for this problem is: Force JEI to load twice. Ofc this has to happen for every mod i write sooooo yeah have 5-6 JEI reloads per recipe reload.
Now none recipe synchronized mods do not have an issue with that because they do not sync their recipes automatically but with JEI it would be mean if you had to reload it in the 2-3 digit range if everyone starts supporting/using that feature.

Mezz said he was planning a API for it. I think that was back in 1.14.4 i couldn't find it yet. (Honestly i was only a simple search through the API not through the implementation)

So is there a way or do i have to do force a JEI reload to get my "Synchronized" data to be seen by JEI?

Also just to point out: I can not move it to later since i rely on tags and Recipes to be loaded before me. Dependency issue. Yes even on the client.

issues.title: Provide a warning level for `IRecipeTransferError` or similar
issues.body:
Currently we are facing the issue that the type of `IRecipeTransferError` is either a hard error or no immediate feedback except for the most observant players paying attention to the tooltip before clicking a button.

Neither is really adequate in some cases to provide useful feedback to a player. Either by not getting their attention quickly or by having them hit a hard wall, which in instead would be easy to solve by a human. For example it is not always easy to match existing itemstacks with NBT against valid ingredients. It can easily be too restrictive and miss valid ones or too permissive and then not work as expected.

In these cases it would be really helpful to provide additional feedback in an immediate way. E.g. by allowing the button to be tinted or just marked as warning and then use red instead of gray. Or replace the `+` with `!`. Or some other symbol. However this might be tricky for texture packs.
This would allow us to inform players about potential issues in a quick and easy way. But not forcing them into a hard wall, because they just put a ingredient into their backpack and the only option is to either cancel everything, grab the missing item and then start all over. Worst case having to traverse a couple levels through a crafting chain again, because they just forgot what intermediate material it was.
Or are left confused because one item not being moved, while it's clearly in their inventory.

Another option might be to allow for a modifer to be pressed similar to `shift`. Say use `ctrl` to allow them to bypass it and allow the the transfer handler to use a best guess approach and provide as many ingredients as possible and maybe leave just 1 or 2 for the player to resolve instead of forcing them to remember all 9 ingredients.

This might probably overlap with  #1040 to some degree.

issues.title: [Feature] Save searche terms as aliases
issues.body:
A really simple and powerful feature to implement would be the ability to simply alias a search, preceded with a symbol such as, say, `!`.

For instance, allow a user to save the search `@enderio conduit -facade` to a quick alias they define called `!conduits`, `@refinedstorage grid -wireless -portable` to `!grids`, and so on. 
If the user then wanted to start working on a system that utilises EnderIO conduits and grids, they can simply search `!conduits refined | !grids` to get the specific items relevant to them without nearly as much typing.

issues.title: [Suggestion] recipe autofill hotkey
issues.body:
JEI currently has the feature to populate a machine/table's inventory or grid to do a certian recipe by clicking the + button when viewing the recipe for the item. However, this requires viewing the recipe for the item, which can get clunky when you are trying to do complex nested crafting [E.G. GregTech]. What i am suggesting is a mouse/keyboard hotbind to automatically populate an inventory or grid with the first valid and available recipe of whatever item you had highlighted.

for example: presing said hotkey (i will refer to it as 'y' for simplicity) on an iron ingot in your crafting table will search through all crafting recipes for iron ingots. if you were to, say, have 9 iron nuggets, and pressed Y, it would put them in the grid. if you were to have an iron block, it would do the same. if you were in a furnace and pressed Y while hovering over an iron ingot, it would put iron ore into the furnace instead. holding shift while pressing Y, will, similar to the + button, populate the machine or table with as much of the recipe as possible, up to a stack of each ingredient. In short, it would function identically to the + button, but with 2 major benfiits. for one thing, it will use whatever recipe results in the item, so you don't have to sort through 20 different wood type recipes for chest (like you have in certian 1.16 modpacks). Secondly, you don't have to pass through the recipe browser GUI first, which can also get annoying when you need to craft something very frequently.

issues.title: JEI not properly updating after reload on servers
issues.body:
I was doing some miscellaneous testing related to using `/reload` for how my recipe lookup works/is implemented in Mekanism and noticed that JEI does not properly update on a dedicated server from `/reload` being called. I believe this was introduced by #2227 (cc: @Alwinfy ) due to the slightly incomplete implementation compared to what I described here: https://github.com/mezz/JustEnoughItems/issues/2217#issuecomment-763172521 which from my understanding is what #2227 was based on. The issue has to do with the fact that on connecting to a server for the first time the server sends the packets in this order:
- Recipes
- Tags (vanilla, then custom types)

BUT on `/reload` it sends the packets in this order:
- Tags (vanilla, then custom types)
- Recipes

The issue with the implementation of #2227 was that while it did address the fact that JEI was doing the updates in the wrong event when connecting to servers, it doesn't have any form of check to validate if the player was already connected and it should be using the other event this time. This causes it to "update" the recipes too early and be stuck with the old outdated copy.

I am not really sure of a good way to implement said fix/change (hence why I am opening it as an issue).

JEI version: 7.6.1.75
Forge version: 36.1.4

issues.title: [Bug] CraftTweaker Create Automated Crafting recipes not visible in JEI
issues.body:
**Forge:** release 1.16.5-forge-36.0.43
**JEI:** [7.6.1.71](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/jei/files/3192904)
**CraftTweaker:** [7.1.0.135](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/crafttweaker/files/3221310)

issues.title: For the "Recipe By:" Feature, Look Up a Data Pack's Name.
issues.body:
This is a feature request.  Currently JEI seems to display Data Pack recipe changes by grabbing the Namespace ID of the recipe, matching it to a ModID, and displaying that.  If it can't find a Mod ID, it will use the Namespace ID and seems to capitalize the first letter.

My example Data Pack is this one: https://github.com/VT-14/VTs_Minecraft_Datapacks/tree/master/FileStructureExample(datapacks_folder)

The Data Pack's name is "Data Pack Name", and that is the name I would like to see the "Recipe By:" note list.

Instead, it shows this: 
![2021-02-28_12 33 45](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/12564251/109428327-a5f85b80-79c4-11eb-96b4-10d3f23fe3e9.png)

The "Recipe By:" shows "Namespace."  For entirely additive changes, that works fine (make the namespace whatever you want to show up).

The issue is that this can cause the "Recipe By:" feature to point at the wrong thing.  The 'normal' way for a Data Pack to tweak a recipe is to replace it under the original namespace.

So if I did a change to a Minecraft item under the Minecraft ID, it would show up like this:
![2021-02-28_12 59 48](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/12564251/109428359-d93aea80-79c4-11eb-8701-3731854fdc16.png)

There is no "Recipe By:" note, implying the recipe is from vanilla Minecraft.  This could cause confusion to players, who previously play on a server or modpack with such tweaked recipes that say they are from the base mod, and then play on a different one and the recipe isn't there.

Alternatively, I could blame an entirely different mod by using their namespace id, such as this:
![2021-02-28_13 01 25](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/12564251/109428414-13a48780-79c5-11eb-91d0-10537b3cfe15.png)

An obvious workaround would be to 'disable' (error out by making invalid) the original recipe and re-add it under a custom namespace, but that's more work and files, and not everyone will know to do that.  If it is reasonably possible, I believe that getting the Data Pack's name rather than just the namespace ID would head off a lot of potential confusion.

issues.title: [1.16.4] Recipes for items with a potion attached (e.g. tipped arrow) display even when removed through a datapack
issues.body:
Minecraft 1.16.4, Forge 35.1.37, JEI 7.6.1.171, Singleplayer

I removed the recipe for tipped arrows through a datapack:
![2021-02-27_00 39 31](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/52419336/109366936-05574e00-7895-11eb-9a1d-1fee55c56f43.png)
(It can also be noted that the night vision arrow has also been hidden from the item list.)

Yet, in both the Uses of the Lingering Potion and the "Show All Recipes" view, this recipe still appears:
![2021-02-27_00 46 06](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/52419336/109367074-65e68b00-7895-11eb-8c33-df27da1169ad.png)
![2021-02-27_00 48 00](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/52419336/109367090-73037a00-7895-11eb-902a-8ef068bb6bda.png)
This applies to all other tipped arrows as well. The recipe for the Uncraftable Arrow (potion minecraft:empty) appears on any lingering potion usage and once in the Show All Recipes view.

This behavior also applies to modded items that are distinguished by their potion NBT. In my pack, I have Reliquary (https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/reliquary-v1-3) installed. Just like with the tipped arrow, I removed the crafting recipe (special crafting serializer, obviously based on the vanilla tipped arrow) through a datapack and I am getting the same issue, with the only difference being that the Uncraftable Potion doesn't show up this time. (I didn't screenshot it, but both of the below also appear in the All Recipes view, alongside all the other potion types.)
![2021-02-27_01 02 00](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/52419336/109367864-96c7bf80-7897-11eb-803e-a550cded06e3.png)
![2021-02-27_00 57 31](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/52419336/109367605-cde9a100-7896-11eb-9747-59c8a4d2ae60.png)
![2021-02-27_00 57 34](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/52419336/109367657-fa052200-7896-11eb-8c48-5750f4a2529c.png)
![2021-02-27_01 02 08](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/52419336/109367878-9c250a00-7897-11eb-93db-0769bf12c803.png)
![2021-02-27_00 57 35](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/52419336/109367660-fd001280-7896-11eb-9339-609597101aab.png)
![2021-02-27_00 57 37](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/52419336/109367664-fffb0300-7896-11eb-80aa-67a4dbcbd3fa.png)
If you have any questions left, feel free to ask. Looking forward to a soon fix!

issues.title: JEI adding invalid space between item id and nbt in /give
issues.body:
**JEI version:** [1.16.4-7.6.1.65](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/jei/files/3157864)

When using give mode in JEI, it is adding an invalid space between item id and nbt, resulting in the following command
```
/give HeckinChloe minecraft:lingering_potion {Potion:"minecraft:long_water_breathing"} 1
```
producing the following message:
```
Expected integer
...ng_potion {Potion:"minecraft:long_water_breathing"} 1<--[HERE]
```

Typing the following actually gives the item:
```diff
- /give HeckinChloe minecraft:lingering_potion {Potion:"minecraft:long_water_breathing"} 1
+ /give HeckinChloe minecraft:lingering_potion{Potion:"minecraft:long_water_breathing"} 1
```

The problematic implementation can be found here:
https://github.com/mezz/JustEnoughItems/blob/fb0edcbd6ca13cb361d684e6d9bdb335d0c51dd9/src/main/java/mezz/jei/util/CommandUtil.java#L96
A solution could be to join id and nbt before passing it to this method

issues.title: Error with addRecipeTransferHandler, Missing Items on an output slot.  Error thrown when recipeSlotCount is set correctly
issues.body:
Short version:

I have a recipe with 3 inputs and 1 output.  But when i do 
    registry.addRecipeTransferHandler(ContainerSolidifier.class, SolidifierRecipeCategory.id,1, 3, ...)
    
A "does not work for container" error is thrown.  When i change it to 
    registry.addRecipeTransferHandler(ContainerSolidifier.class, SolidifierRecipeCategory.id,1, 4, ...)
This error goes away, but now the transfer is broken because it is treating the OUTPUT slot as an input.

Long version with code links and screenshots


So i have a custom recipe that takes 3 items as input, and also uses some fluid, and produces 1 recipe as output.

So, similar to every other recipe, i have a  addRecipeTransferHandler 

https://github.com/Lothrazar/Cyclic/blob/ea92e651181998c325dc8a02ae81cd87e7fd90cd/src/main/java/com/lothrazar/cyclic/compat/jei/CyclicPluginJEI.java#L73

As shown in screenshot, there is an output slot on the right.
![for jei](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/621529/104139814-c9a70a00-5362-11eb-94ed-48b3f8138470.png)

So i have recipeSlotStart = 1, this means to skip the output slot  at zero
and then, what should be the case is that i use recipeSlotCount = 3, since there are 3 input slots

But if i put in recipeSlotCount  =3 here ( we are talking about the second integer argument to addRecipeTransferHandler, which is really the fourth argument), then it errors with "does not work for container" https://github.com/mezz/JustEnoughItems/blob/2ff644d19a9444f5fe4764be3b2fa1446a4859ec/src/main/java/mezz/jei/transfer/BasicRecipeTransferHandler.java#L79

This doesnt make sense, as my recipe clearly has exactly 3 inputs.  This is set both in my category and my recipe

Here, only slots 0,1,2 are set as inputs
https://github.com/Lothrazar/Cyclic/blob/ea92e651181998c325dc8a02ae81cd87e7fd90cd/src/main/java/com/lothrazar/cyclic/compat/jei/SolidifierRecipeCategory.java#L73

And also here 
https://github.com/Lothrazar/Cyclic/blob/ea92e651181998c325dc8a02ae81cd87e7fd90cd/src/main/java/com/lothrazar/cyclic/block/solidifier/RecipeSolidifier.java#L42


Since JEI forces me to set this as 4, its treating the output slot as input. Meaning it tells me theres a "Missing item" for the OUTPUT slot
![missing item](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/621529/104139811-c6ac1980-5362-11eb-82da-89344cea72d2.png)

I tried checking out the wiki but it does not talk about these arguments at all, there is no info on the wiki about this 
https://github.com/mezz/JustEnoughItems/wiki/Recipe-Transfer-Handlers

issues.title: A respectful ask for the ability to manually sort items within JEI, and few other things.
issues.body:
### Summary
The core idea is the ability to manually sort items within JEI using item's string names. This would be an option within the config, for it would by default it would make the JEI blank. This would be done by parsing a text file of ID's.

**Example:**
`<minecraft:stone>, <minecraft:stone:1>, <minecraft:stone:2>`
Which would sort into the JEI in the order:
Granite, Polished Granite, Stone



### A few extra feature ideas relative:
 - The ability to have items blink between one another in a single grid cell liken to in recipes.
**Example:**
In the text file, when using <minecraft:stone:*>, all of the items under the ID list will condense within one cell and flicker between one another as a single cell in the JEI.

 - The ability to create array elements, in order to list particular items within one cell in the JEI, that don't have the same ID. Array lists would be sorted by default alphabetically within the JEI, or by placement within the text file.
**Example:**
`ToolsArray = {
<minecraft:wood_pickaxe>,
<minecraft:stone_pickaxe>,
<minecraft:iron_pickaxe>,
<minecraft:gold_pickaxe>,
<minecraft:diamond_pickaxe>
}`

- The ability to sort recipes and uses by recipe name, alphabetically.
- The ability to create custom strings to search within JEI. Custom strings can be created inside a .txt file. Within the search bar you will type >StringName to search for it

issues.title: Idea for recipe lookup with JEI
issues.body:
My idea is based on how you can look up recipes and uses for an item with JEI.

The idea is that you can press whatever key you have for Show Uses, and instead of pulling up every recipe for that item in whatever order is used currently, it will show first the recipes that can be made using that item, and whatever other items are in your inventory at that time.

For example, if I have a bucket and steel ingots (mekanism mod) in my inventory, and I press "U", (the default keybind) having it show me a Jerrycan (immersive engineering) which requires iron ingots, is pretty useless, but having it show me Basic Mechanical Pipes (mekanism) is very handy.

Now, I am not suggesting that the other recipes should not be shown, just that the most relevant recipes should be shown first.

issues.body:
After countless hours of reinstalling mods and trying pre-made packs every time I try to play on my local server, it says "The Server must have JEI installed" when it has the mod already in the mods folder.


Please help

issues.title: Tags used befor it was bound during client load connecting on server
issues.body:
When a player join a server tags and recipes are sent with two separates packet. JEI starts when the recipes packet is received (using `RecipesUpdatedEvent`).
If the tag packaet hasen't been received yet and a mod plugin uses tags an exception (`java.lang.IllegalStateException: Tag <tag> used before it was bound`) will be thrown.

It may also be the cause of https://github.com/mezz/JustEnoughItems/issues/2165

issues.title: Add support for buttons with larger than 2x2 px edges
issues.body:
Edit: Apologies for the "do" in the title. I initially wrote something like "Buttons do not scale properly", but upon closer examination it seems like they *do*, but it's rather a design limitation. Whether intentional or not, I am not certain.

I was making an add-on for a resource pack to enable it to use JEI, and came across this.

![2020-11-26_16 27 16](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/17690187/100394954-9a337c80-3004-11eb-85a1-1139a367330e.png)

Notice the buttons on the page selection, and recipe type selection. These do not scale properly. For reference, this is button_enabled in the resource pack I am making:

![button_enabled](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/17690187/100395113-3c536480-3005-11eb-82e3-0efcea53b05e.png)

As everything aligns itself with the lower left hand corner of the sprite, repeating the central 14x14 pixels of the sprite as needed, until 2 pixels away from the edge of the button. Then, it simply uses the outer 2 pixels for edging. This ends up breaking any sort of edging that the texture may use.

This works fine - technically - with the default textures for buttons, it does make texturing very annoying. A 2px edge is not a lot to work with. Any kind of detailing with that res is either incredibly simplistic or nigh impossible to do.

As the smallest button size in the UI - to my knowledge - is 13x13, this 2 px edge restriction seems unnecessary. It would be nice to see this be raised to a 4 or larger edge. Again, unless I am wrong - the smallest button is 13x13, so you could logically use the outer 6 px just fine.

issues.title: Undeclared Dependency on FTB GUI Library
issues.body: Not an issue with the mod itself per se, but with how it's listed on CurseForge. The JEI Config UI requires [FTB GUI Library](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/ftb-gui-library), but this is not listed as [a relation](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/jei/relations/dependencies) on CurseForge. This makes it easy to miss the dependency when assembling a modpack, negatively impacting accessibility/configurability.

issues.title: Unable to download JEI
issues.body:
When I start up a modpack with JEI for the first time, it will stop responding when it starts unpacking/downloading JEI files.

My RAM seems to be fine, but my processor just goes rambo and uses every bit of power to keep it from crashing.
It takes ages before it crashes itself and just gives me an exit code: 0.

issues.title: Unable to get items
issues.body: Hello! I'm not sure if this is just because of me or if the server I'm on somehow has an anti-cheat, but I seem to be unable to drag items from the JEI list into my inventory. Any fixes?

issues.title: Remove Pagination for bookmarks if only a single page is present
issues.body:
I would argue that 99% of people will never have more than a single page of bookmarks. 

Combined with the fact that the left side of the GUI tends to be where most mods have moved their GUI elements (most likely due to JEI in the first place), it makes me feel like the buttons are more in the way than anything else.

issues.title: [1.16.3] Huge memory leak on disconnect/reconnect
issues.body:
## Environment
**Minecraft version**: 1.16.3
**JEI version**: jei-1.16.4-7.6.0.52.jar

## Reproduction
1. Join a server
2. Note minimum used RAM after GC in F3 menu
3. Disconnect
4. Repeat

Every time you join, the minimum used RAM is increased with about 400MB, depending on how many items are defined in JEI. As you can imagine, this quickly eats up all the allocated RAM and starts severely stuttering, ultimately crashing with OOM.

I took a heap dump via JProfiler and noticed this:

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/2650170/98469984-54487d00-21eb-11eb-9b38-d577bd2f8bcd.png)

Apparently, a new instance of `IngredientFilter` (and `RecipeManager`?) is allocated on each join. I tried to trace the incoming references in hopes I will find the source, but there's just too many. If you need any other information from the heap dump, please let me know and I will do my best to provide it.

issues.title: Various minor accessibility improvements [Feature request]
issues.body: I'm a modpack maker and I was talking with someone on my Discord that mentioned that they had trouble using Minecraft's crafting system due to a disability of theirs. After a short discussion we had a few ideas that could be implemented in JEI's framework that would improve accessibility. The biggest one would be the ability to set JEI's gui scaling independently of Minecraft's so that the items could be made much larger than normal and easier to see. Another was to add the ability to map the function the plus sign currently has (popping items into the grid) to a hotkey in addition to another hotkey for taking the finished item from the crafting grid and into the player inventory.

issues.title: 1.15 to 1.16 - IGuiContainerHandler change creates compatibility issues.
issues.body:
There might be a reason that this change was made, but as is, going from:

`public interface IGuiContainerHandler<T extends ContainerScreen>`

to

`public interface IGuiContainerHandler<T extends ContainerScreen<?>>`

is a breaking change which prevents me implementing this using my own parameterized class.

My 1.15 code is as follows: `public class PanelBounds implements IGuiContainerHandler<ContainerScreenCoFH>`

In 1.16, attempting to change this declaration to: `public class PanelBounds implements IGuiContainerHandler<ContainerScreenCoFH<?>>` appears to work, but then doesn't as it fails in the main plugin instead with the following error:

`java: method addGuiContainerHandler in interface mezz.jei.api.registration.IGuiHandlerRegistration cannot be applied to given types;
  required: java.lang.Class<? extends T>,mezz.jei.api.gui.handlers.IGuiContainerHandler<T>
  found: java.lang.Class<cofh.core.client.gui.ContainerScreenCoFH>,cofh.core.plugins.jei.PanelBounds
  reason: cannot infer type-variable(s) T
    (argument mismatch; java.lang.Class<cofh.core.client.gui.ContainerScreenCoFH> cannot be converted to java.lang.Class<? extends cofh.core.client.gui.ContainerScreenCoFH<?>>)`

Basically, can we just remove that <?> as it seems unnecessary and is causing some issues?

issues.title: Recipe Ordering
issues.body:
Hi,

This is not much of an issue as it is a question. I am using a mod called Artisan Worktables to make custom recipes for certain items, mostly equipment. My question, is there a way to re-order the recipe tabs when you select the item to see how to make it? At the moment my new recipe using the custom table is the last option and the first option that appears is the enchantments on the anvil.

I am asking the mod creator as well if he has had this issue but I wasn't sure which of you would have more control over this.

![JEI, artisan recipe issue](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/38624271/92429033-c7d3fc80-f15e-11ea-83d2-e1a69621025a.png)

issues.title: [1.16.1] Major Server Lag
issues.body:
When I use JEI in my single player game it runs fine, but on the modded server it causes lag every few seconds (without having the menu open). When I take JEI out of the mods the server runs smoothly.

Thanks for taking the time!

issues.title: Unable to toggle cheat mode on macOS
issues.body: Ctrl+click on the settings button in JEI 7.3.2.25 does not toggle cheat mode on macOS since ctrl+left click on the trackpad is bound to right click at the system level. I think [this](https://github.com/mezz/JustEnoughItems/blob/e01c9aad01f3a9f89eee41606201bf215d95cb82/src/main/java/mezz/jei/gui/overlay/ConfigButton.java#L73) needs to be changed to check `GLFW.GLFW_KEY_LEFT_SUPER` and `GLFW.GLFW_KEY_RIGHT_SUPER ` if `Minecraft.IS_RUNNING_ON_MAC` is true.

issues.title: Mouse-over hotkeys take precedent over typing in search
issues.body:
**Issue:** 
When typing in a search request if the player moves the mouse over an item in the item list JEI will not lock the mouse-over hotkeys. This results in the A key adding to bookmarks, the R key looking for recipes to make the item with, and U looking for uses for the item.

**Expected Result:**
With the search bar focused, mouse-over hotkeys should lock and become unusable until the search bar becomes unfocused.

**Steps to reproduce:**
1. Click the search bar to focus it
2. Move the mouse over an item in the item list
3. Start typing anything that uses a JEI mouse over hot-key (ex: A, R, U)

**Versions:**
Minecraft: 1.16.1
Forge: 32.0.108
JEI: 7.0.1.9

issues.title: Bookmark tab suggestion
issues.body:
Suggestion 
Could you make it so that the bookmarks can have stack numbers. What I mean is that clicking on an item again and again increase the number of that item in the bookmarks tab and vice versa for decreasing the number of items. You can also shift click on an item in bookmarks tab to remove. I feel that almost everyone uses bookmarks as a to do list of some sort and having the number of items you need drastically improves planning for automations.

issues.title: ISubtypeInterpreter should have 2 variants
issues.body:
ISubtypeInterpreter has a foundational flaw.
It is shared for the Overlay and Recipe Check.

Scenario using Thermal Expansion.
Thermal Expansion has Energy Blocks that have Empty/Full Variants in creative tab. But the charge is meaningless for the recipe since these are only there for the convenience.

With the current  ISubtypeInterpreter  implementation there is 2 choices you can make right now.

- 1: Use Sub-types and let them display in the overlay but only the Empty one will be able to be used in Recipes while the other is just for Creative use there. This includes even custom ones that could have any energy value in them. As long they are not empty they wont help with recipes.
- 2: Don't Sub-types and have any item be usable for recipe checking. But all the Convenience features are gone.

Solution:
Have 2 ISubtypeInterpreter classes or 2 Registries that allow to split these subtypes from recipes and overlay so the moddev can decide whats important for recipes and what is important for display.

Issue is between 1.14-1.16

@mezz ping you since you requested this be a issue.

issues.title: [1.12.2] Crash with Forge Gradle 3 (ATs)
issues.body:
### The problem
The issue has been previously mentioned in #2009. However, @mezz closed the issue as solved, but the issue still persists (it was probably reintroduced with 4.16.1).

In short, the issue lies in Access Transformer handling in Forge Gradle 3. It seems that Forge Gradle 3 does not use the Access Transformers provided by JEI. As such, it fails to start because of `IllegalAccessException`.

A temporary workaround is to copy-paste the JEI AT into your own Access Transformer config, but that seems rather impractical in the long run. Especially when you want to just use JEI as a nice tool to help debugging your own mod.

### The solution I am proposing:
If viable, upload a  FG3-compatible 1.12.2 JEI version (4.16.0 most probably) to the maven repository.

issues.title: Bookmark Management
issues.body:
Hello,

First thanks for a mod that has become essential.

My suggestion is about the Bookmarks (as the title suggests). I am not sure how others use them but I have a "core" set of items that I always make. I have these bookmarked. However, when I start adding more bookmarks things begin feeling crowded. I would suggest that there be a button to open another interface. This interface would allow you to group bookmarks (perhaps with titles of the groups). Rearrange bookmarks and delete whole groups if you want and such.

As it is the bookmarks have the ability to have multiple pages, What I would envision would be perhaps three or four windows where the current large window is. You could move the bookmarks from one to another. If you need more than four then you hit the next page button and you have four more.

I believe that a change like this could add increased utility to the bookmarks section and add real value to the mod.

Thanks,

<enhancement>

issues.title: Also document blocks with no direct item form
issues.body:
There exist many blocks (in vanilla and modded) which do not have a direct item form (attached stems, potted plants, wall versions of blocks, etc.), and these are not displayed in the JEI menu. While not currently a problem, such blocks can have unique loot tables, and following on from #1925, if they are to be documented, having these appear in the JEI menu alongside other blocks may become neccessary.

Potential minor problems may arise from documenting these; for one, as they have no item form, how they would appear in the menu would not be defined, so JEI may have to provide sprites for the blocks in question for them to show up with a valid texture.

issues.title: [1.12.2] JEI using up way too much RAM
issues.body:
Hi there,

I've been using _trying to_ use JEI in a mod pack that I've put together, and it's eating up RAM faster than Chrome with a hundred tabs open.

Prior to adding JEI to the pack, I was able to run the 100+ modpack with 8GB of RAM without any issues. Since adding JEI to the pack, I'm unable to get past `[jei]: Building ingredient filter`. I was _barely_ able to get it to load once I allocated 30GB of RAM, but having to load allocate 30GB of ram just to get JEI to load seems a little excessive to me, considering that some of the friends I'm playing with have a max of 16GB.

I've tried suggestions from issues #746, #1836, and #1581 

Disabling VSync as suggested in #746 and #1581 did not resolve the issue. Adding JVM arguments as suggested in #1836 didn't resolve the issue, and neither did disabling `colorSearch` in the jei config as suggested in #1581. 

**Machine Specs**:
- **CPU:** 16x Intel(R) Core(TM) i9-9880HK @ 2.40Ghz (8 phys. cores, 16 threads)
- **RAM:** 32GB (2400 MHz DDR4)
- **GPU:** AMD Radeon Pro Vega 20 (4GB HBM2)

**Versions:**
- **Minecraft:** 1.12.2
- **Forge:** 1.12.2-14.23.5.2847
- **JEI:** 4.15.0.291

**JVM Arguments (Client 8G):**
`-XX:+UseConcMarkSweepGC`, `-XX:+DisableExplicitGC`, `-XX:+CMSParallelRemarkEnabled`, `-XX:+UseBiasedLocking`, `-XX:SurvivorRatio=90`, `-XX:ReservedCodeCache=4096m`, `-XX:ParallelGCThreads=12`

**JVM Arguments (Client 30G):**
`-XX:+UseConcMarkSweepGC`, `-XX:+DisableExplicitGC`, `-XX:+CMSParallelRemarkEnabled`, `-XX:+UseBiasedLocking`, `-XX:SurvivorRatio=90`, `-XX:ReservedCodeCache=15360m`, `-XX:ParallelGCThreads=12`

**JVM Arguments (Server 12G):**
`-XX:+UseConcMarkSweepGC`, `-XX:+DisableExplicitGC`, `-XX:+CMSParallelRemarkEnabled`, `-XX:+UseBiasedLocking`, `-XX:SurvivorRatio=8`, `-XX:ReservedCodeCacheSize=2048m`, `-XX:ParallelGCThreads=8`, `-Dfml.readTimeout=90`

When loading with 8GB allocated, I get the error: `java.lang.OutOfMemoryError: Java heap space`.

When loading with 30GB allocated, it takes anywhere from 30-45 minutes just to load.

Once I do get it to load, connecting to a server is next to impossible because loading JEI causes a timeout.

issues.title: Show unique uses of items
issues.body:
Hi! I don't think this feature exists, if it does, I am sorry! It would be very handy if there was a way, when checking the uses of an item, by right clicking in JEI for example, to see unique uses. So, excluding those that are enabled via the ore dictionary.
For example, I have the Natura and Tinkers Construct mods, now if I check the usages of Bloodwood Planks (from Natura) I will see pages over pages of recipes and usages for any kind of wood planks. I would love to have a way of only showing uses, where Bloodwood Planks are required, for example only bloodwood slabs, and the Tinker stats for Bloodwood.
I hope I'm explaining this clearly!

Thanks a lot in advance :)

issues.title: 1.12.2 Crash when an Agricraft / OpenComputers compat item is rendered in JEI
issues.body:
[CRASHLOG HERE](https://paste.dimdev.org/giwaragayu.mccrash)

Minecraft version: 1.12.2
Forge Version: 14.23.5.2847

What I was doing when it happened: Searching for "conduit" in JEI, crash occurred when reaching the "n", log points to "Computer **con**trolled seed analyzer" from Agricraft, this item only exists if OpenComputers is also present.

Modpack used: Custom modpack I put together called the "Stuffed Crust Pizza Pack" that's available on CurseForge, crash occurs on version "Pepperoni R2.0.0". Modpack page located [HERE](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/modpacks/stuffed-crust-pizza-pack) 

Recently the modpack was updated and JEI was updated from 4.15.0.289 Beta to 4.15.0.291 Release. Additionally, OpenComputers was added in said update, but Agricraft was already present. Forge was also updated from 14.23.5.2846 to 14.23.5.2847 (necessary for updating another mod). Before those changes were made, searching for that term did not cause a crash, presumably because the aforementioned item that seems to be causing the crash when it's rendered in JEI (the computer controlled seed analyzer) only exists / is registered when OpenComputers is also present. I wasn't sure if this crash is related to Agricraft / InfinityLib or Just Enough Items so I'm submitting this here as InfinityLib and Agricraft have not been updated since 2018, so any support from issue-reporting to those is unlikely, as well as the crashlog seems to implicate it's the rendering of the item causing it though I don't know if that's something in JEI with rendering code or the actual model of the Agricraft item implicated by the crash. None of the three mods have anything related to this item nor this compatibility in their configs. If necessary and there's nothing to be done I'm prepared to alter the modpack to fix this problem if I really have to.

Thank you for your time.

issues.title: 1.14.4 : IRecipeCategoryExtension#drawInfo() never appears to be called
issues.body:
Hi - I'm trying to get JEI support working for PneumaticCraft in 1.14.4, and I understand that custom (modded) recipe wrappers should now implement `IRecipeCategoryExtension` rather than `IRecipeWrapper`.

The problem I'm seeing is that my overridden `IRecipeCategoryExtension#drawInfo()` (and also `IRecipeCategoryExtension#getTooltipStrings()`methods) aren't being called by JEI at all, so I can't do any custom drawing for my recipes.

Looking at the 1.12.2 JEI source, `IRecipeWrapper#drawInfo()` was called from `RecipeLayout#drawRecipe()`.  The equivalent code in 1.14.4 doesn't call `drawInfo()`.

Is this an oversight in JEI, or am I misunderstanding how to handle recipe wrappers in the new version?

issues.title: JEI Packet size issue with oredict recipes causes disconnect with error
issues.body:
When transferring items to crafting that have a large ore dictionary count, such as Enderio "Iron Alloy Ingot" or Actually Additions "Greenhouse Glass", or many other items that have wood/plants/glass in recipes, you will be disconnected with:

```
[13:53:25] [Netty Client IO #2/ERROR] [FML]: NetworkDispatcher exception java.lang.IllegalArgumentException: Payload may not be larger than 32767 bytes at
...
```

I'm not 100% sure how you can fix this, aside from perhaps client-side, picking *one* recipe in the ore dictionary, then sending that to the server, instead of iterating every single combination in one massive packet.

This would rely on recipes being identical on client and server, however I think that they already should be with any mods and packs, as issues would ensue if otherwise.

It looks like you may already have a fix that perhaps isn't implemented?  Either that or the dev found a fix by workaround... 
https://github.com/p455w0rd/JustEnoughEnergistics/issues/4#issuecomment-456227165

issues.body:
Using ItemStages 1.12.2-2.0.49 with JEI 4.15.0.291 on Forge 14.23.5.2847.

When using ItemsStages serious, consistent JEI desyncs can occur.

In detail: if I hit the + button on JEI to auto-insert items into any crafting grid they are inserted only on the server but not on the client, which not only makes further crafting impossible until the GUI is closed, but also causes heavy inventory desync issues. Sometimes just looking up a recipe (so without hitting +) is causing a desync and makes the crafting table unusable until the GUI is closed. I can't see a pattern here, but the issues happen very consistently, rendering JEI unusable.

This happens in singleplayer and LAN games. Switching between that sometimes cures the desync for a while.

Note: https://github.com/Darkhax-Minecraft/ItemStages/issues/54

issues.title: [Suggestion] Configurable Anvil Recipes from the VanillaPlugin
issues.body:
Currently the anvil recipes in vanilla JEI will register all of the same item repair, material repair, and book enchantment recipes it can.

This makes sense, but in a modpack with a large amount of equipment variety and enchantments, this can result in JEI creating tens of thousands of anvil recipes.

The issue with tens of thousands of anvil recipes is the RAM requirement. I found that in a 1.12.2 modpack with 64,000 anvil recipes (large amount of enchantments and armor variety), the anvil recipes alone would take 250mb of RAM.

It would be really convenient to be able to configure the vanilla plugin's anvil recipe maker to choose which anvil recipe types to skip registering.

issues.title: Missing Brewing Recipes
issues.body:
This is probably not all that high priority, but earlier today I was working on creating an EMC Mapper for Brewing Recipes and I came across an odd thing. JEI is missing two *valid* Vanilla brewing stand recipes.

Potion of luck + gunpowder -> splash potion of luck
Splash potion of luck + dragons breath -> lingering potion of luck

I believe the reason JEI does not find either of these recipes is that they are not declared in `PotionBrewing`, but I did test them and they do in fact work in the brewing stand.

The reason I believe this is probably rather low priority is that given the base potion of luck cannot even be crafted anyways, it doesn't really matter there are no recipes for its children.

Forge Version: 28.1.80

https://github.com/pupnewfster/ProjectE/blob/nbt_nss/src/main/java/moze_intel/projecte/emc/mappers/BrewingMapper.java The mapper I made to find all the recipes.

issues.title: [Request] Filtering Recipe/Item Usage GUIs
issues.body:
After posting some JEI tips on reddit, I have been asked whether it was possible to display the usages of an item but only display results from a specific mod. The user wanted to know how they could search for e.g. all uses of iron ingots that result in an item from Mystical Agriculture, or all recipes containing glass that result in a Blood Magic item, etc.

Perhaps it would be interesting to display an additional search bar for the recipe and usage GUIs that allows the user to filter results, or add an additional search prefix for the main search bar that would only affect results of the recipe and ingredient GUIs. This way you could not only search for recipes that result in an item from a specific mod, but also display recipes that use not only iron ingots but also sand as an ingredient, or recipes that use lapis and result in a blue item, or recipes that use stone and result in a block (e.g. filtering by oredict entries that contain `block`), and other such things.

I'm aware that this would most likely require considerable effort to implement (since there's currently no way to filter the recipe or usage GUIs at all), with relatively little payoff. Nevertheless, if there's an easy way of doing this, it may be worth considering. And making a suggestion never hurts, right?

issues.title: [1.14.4] Fluids with colors aren't being rendered in JEI (present but 'invisible')
issues.body:
Forge version: **1.14.4-28.1.39**
JEI version: **jei-1.14.4:6.0.0.16**
Java: **Java 8**

If a custom Fluid has a color assigned to its attributes, JEI does not render the fluid texture properly (as in not at all but the item is present in JEI if you hover over it). I tried: a MaterialColor's colorValue, hardcoded rgb int as in '0xff0000', and a few other things, thinking perhaps the color value needed to be encoded somehow for FluidStackRenderer. No luck. When I removed the color completely, everything worked swimmingly and the fluid texture was drawn properly in JEI.

[code snip -- assume 'still' and 'flowing' are location of textures and MILK/FLOWING_MILK are static FlowingFluid references]
```
MILK = new ForgeFlowingFluid.Source(new ForgeFlowingFluid.Properties(()->MILK,()->FLOWING_MILK,
                                      FluidAttributes.builder(still,flowing)
                                                     .viscosity(1200).density(1200).color(MaterialColor.SNOW.colorValue))
                                     .block(()->MILK_BLOCK).bucket(()->Items.MILK_BUCKET).renderLayer(BlockRenderLayer.SOLID));
FLOWING_MILK = new ForgeFlowingFluid.Flowing(new ForgeFlowingFluid.Properties(()->MILK,()->FLOWING_MILK,
                                      FluidAttributes.builder(still,flowing)
                                                     .viscosity(1200).density(1200).color(MaterialColor.SNOW.colorValue))
                                     .block(()->MILK_BLOCK).bucket(()->Items.MILK_BUCKET).renderLayer(BlockRenderLayer.SOLID));

```

issues.title: JEI calls the wrong burn time method on 1.14 causing JEI to not work at all.
issues.body:
Log: https://gist.github.com/jaredlll08/d927e1c2e6b1a00c0388e763867008d1

So basically, I have a CrafttTweaker script which is removing an item (white wool) from the wool tag, doing so causes JEI to crash.

Looking at the code, I think it is basically, JEI looks at the map and caches fuel items, then CrafttTweaker comes in and removes items from tags. JEI then goes and tries to get the burn values of those items, calling this method: https://gist.github.com/jaredlll08/214f60eb4c020ea1590f686cc05710ba
here:
https://github.com/mezz/JustEnoughItems/blob/1.14/src/main/java/mezz/jei/plugins/vanilla/cooking/fuel/FuelRecipeMaker.java#L26

Which regenerates the map of fuels based on tags, because white wool is now no longer in that map, but is still in your fuel cache, it tries to get it's value, and ends up using the default of 0 as defined here:

https://github.com/mezz/JustEnoughItems/blob/1.14/src/main/java/mezz/jei/plugins/vanilla/cooking/fuel/FuelRecipeMaker.java#L41


Current thoughts on a fix would be:
Don't use the Deprecated vanilla method and instead use the Forge method, as I believe that is updated when tags are updated.

If you need the 1.14 version of CrafttTweaker to test this yourself, just reach out on discord :)

_This issue was originally reported to the Everlasting Abilities issue tracker: https://github.com/CyclopsMC/EverlastingAbilities/issues/127_

Using the `fillItemGroup` method, the subitems are filled into the creative tab.
However, **when looking up the Totem with JEI, only one variant is shown**.
Is it possible that JEI is doing some kind of filtering to hide these other subitems?

issues.title: Cheat mode not working in survival?
issues.body:
I'm not sure if this is a known issue or not, or if i am missing something, but if i am on a server then cheat mode doesn't work, as in: i can't spawn any item. At first i thought the command used to summon said items was defined incorrectly, but the mod no longer has any options or config files like in previous versions, like 1.12.2. 

My guess is that the issue i'm experiencing is linked to the fact that JEI seems to have changed how it spawns items in 1.14.4. It used to be that if you click or right click an item in the list, it would add one/a stack of a specific kind of item to the player inventory, now instead it shows the amount of items next to your cursor when you click it from the item list, and you then have to click the item back into your inventory to place it there.

issues.title: JEI showing incorrect item amount
issues.body:
When I started playing at first everything was normal, but after a while JEI started to show incorrect recipes. More ingredients would be shown to be required than are actually needed. The recipes where this occurs and the amount of items that is shown seems to be a bit random, but it does appear to be consistent between reboots of the game or my PC. It has become especially annoying considering I am using Refined Storage as well, and this bug causes me to consume way more items than needed.

My observations and testing results are listed below:

 - Not every item is shown to need too much (see screenshot: 2x iron ingots but 1x stone gear)
 - The recipe still works with the correct amount of items
 - Vanilla _and_ modded items/recipes are subject to the bug (Vanilla iron ingots in 1st screenshot, Thermal Foundation copper in 2nd screenshot)
 - When shift-clicking the recipe in Refined Storage pattern grid, the correct amount of items is shown, but when creating the pattern the incorrect amount of items is written in the pattern
 - Not every recipe is subject to the bug (screenshot 5 and 6)
 - The amount of items shown as needed varies per recipe (2 in screenshot 1, 3 in screenshot 2, 10 in screenshot 7)
 - If you have the correct amount of items it does allow you to click the "+" to add them to the crafting grid and shows none as missing.  - When crafting an item with Refined Storage, the incorrect amount of items is consumed (as written in the pattern) instead of the correct amount, but only when autocrafting (with an incorrect pattern)
 - Turning off the "Oredict" option in the Refined Storage pattern grid causes the correct amount to be written to the pattern (but without Oredictionary support). Having the "Oredict" option enabled causes the wrong amount of items to be written to the pattern as is shown in the JEI interface (but only if that recipe has a wrong item count to begin with).

issues.title: [Feature Request] Item Grouping
issues.body:
These are the types of blocks, as I see it: Cubes, slabs, stairs, others (mods, like slopes, etc.).

One thing that particularly irks me about JEI is that it seems not to support this.

So, it's just like Robocraft X or Scrap Mechanic:

In the list of blocks, you'll have Stone Block, then Stone Stairs, then Stone Slab, then Wood Block, Wood Stairs, etc.

It all could just go into their respective category instead of filling up the screen with variations of the same block, but no. The same for tools like pickaxes and swords. 

Alternatively, you could group blocks by block texture: cubes, slabs, stairs, etc, go into Wood, Stone, Birch, etc, respectively.

issues.title: Tab Prioritization
issues.body:
Hello,
   I think a very nice feature for JEI would be a Recipe Tab Prioritization list in the config.  It is very common that people playing custom recipe packs overlook recipes because they don't show up on the first tab when viewing them.  And quite often, if a vanilla recipe is removed, the first thing that shows up is useless anvil enchantments.

At the very least, adding the option to make any recipes that are added in Crafttweaker be on the first tab in "R" recipe view would be a big step in the right direction.  As a modpack maker, if I add a custom recipe, thats the recipe I expect the player to use... having to remember to search for the machine up top and hit the tab for it is just extra inconvenient steps that quite often makes the player think the recipe has been disabled.

issues.title: [Suggestion] Recipes without JEI
issues.body:
Hello!

Let's get straight to it: My suggestion is to allow users to disable the JEI interface entirely (similarly to when you do CTRL+O, but without the two buttons on the bottom) yet still allow users to press "R" and "U" on items to see uses and recipies.

I've been wanting to make a modpack for a while that continues to capture the "vanilla-esc" Minecraft experience, and one of the major things that interests me is allowing users to see recipes *without* the in-game recipe book. However, I do not want the item menu or the search bar. Think of it like this: In your "NEI Features" spreadsheet, you show two sections for "Item List" and "Recipes." I'd love to have the funtionality of just "Recipes" without the "Item List", if that makes sense.

Of course this is just a suggestion and nothing is required, but it'd be an absolutely lovely configuration option for avid modpack makers like me! :)

issues.title: [Feature Request] Filter Tabs
issues.body:
Since mod packs have a lot of items it would be nice to have them sorted by default . . . rather than showing the players several hundred pages of items . . . why not start the mod with a blank side panel and show them the creative tabs over the top of it . . . moved to the side instead of blocking the inventory as it does in the actual game mode.

Then players can search by just clicking on the different tabs rather than having to use the @ commands . . . and if you click on the search tab you can use the mod as it is by default right now. 

The configuration file could allow a pack creator to hide some tabs from players in survival mode, and add their own custom tabs . . . for example if I have both Primal Tech and Primal core in my mod pack and I could sort the items from both mods into tabs that fit the pack I'm working on. 

By making it easy for players to go through all the items in a pack a little at a time they might not be overwhelmed, and they wouldn't have to know what to search for ahead of time . . . which might encourage them to use mods they've never heard of more often.

issues.title: Recipes being cached even when removed
issues.body:
Similar to #705, but I didn't see some particulars noted there that I have here:

I moved all recipes for crafting sticks to a different mechanic and used `recipes.remove(<ore:stickWood>)` in my CraftTweaker script, and JEI no longer shows any of the vanilla table stick recipes _except_ for [this one](https://i.imgur.com/IwYtflc.png) which:

- accepts two of any `logWood`, one atop the other
- does NOT show a [recipe ID](https://i.imgur.com/lld1ixC.png)
- cannot actually [be crafted](https://i.imgur.com/jfjN0RR.png) even using the exact recipe (down to the item) shown in that screenshot

All other vanilla workbench recipes to craft sticks have been removed from JEI, as expected. This recipe is, IIRC, not vanilla, but I don't know the originating mod. If I had to make a guess, I'd say that maybe some mod is adding its recipes at a strange time and this is getting stuck in the cache? I have _other_ items that I've removed all vanilla workbench recipes for, and they aren't showing up in JEI like this anymore. As an earlier test, using `recipes.removeAll()` in my script left [over a thousand pages](https://i.imgur.com/SoUBLuX.png) of vanilla workbench recipes showing, none of which seemed to actually be craftable. issues.title: Fix or toggle for ingredient filter building.
issues.body:
I've seen quite a few reports of loading times being extremely long, or just crashing altogether with JEI, simply due to there being a large number of block IDs present. Considering that the large number of block IDs only cause an issue when JEI is installed, and work fine on their own otherwise, I think this needs to be addressed by JEI.
If optimizing the ingredient filter building stage further is not possible. I suggest either a toggle to disable the ingredient feature entirely, or a blacklist of mods to not apply it to.
Currently JEI is the only obstacle in the way of me loading the game with a high block ID count, so I see "just reduce the number of blocks" as a valid solution.

chronological order (no duplicates and updated sort order when a search is repeated) would go great with the quality of life improvement of bookmarking.

Edit: After reading this https://github.com/mezz/JustEnoughItems/issues/525#issuecomment-254374837 I realize now that this functionality is already in but I did not know about it as it is not communicated through the GUI. As such I will change the nature of the suggestion to offer some hotkey based functionality via GUI elements as well.

Another candidate for this would be the "back" (backspace) functionality since a lot of people do not know about this one either.

PS: It seems like that with the introduction of the bookmark the issue I linked to is now Closed.

issues.title: [1.13.2] Having trouble getting custom categories to work
Change save location of Bookmarks.ini (bookmark save file)
issues.body:
There's debate in other requests on whether bookmarks should exist per world, or be account-wide.  The decision on that MAY influence where you move the file's save location (within the World/Save folder, or the main MC directory like JourneyMap or Prestige's data), but is beyond the scope of my actual request.

My request?  Move the Bookmarks.ini file's save location SOMEWHERE outside the config folder.  When updating modpacks, this can result in the bookmarks file being erased.  Even if updated manually into a new instance, finding a file in the config folder to move over to a new MultiMC instance is a bit counter-intuitive.

Thanks!

issues.title: [suggestion] Add a search bar for filtering bookmarks
issues.body:
Bookmarks is a great feature to JEI, but sometimes when you have too many, I feel that you should still be able to search for them in the same way as you do normal items, but only bookmarked items. 

About the bar itself:
* The bar can go to the right of the bookmark button.
* The bookmark show button must be enabled to show the bar.
* Configured search options will also apply in the same way as the normal search bar rules.
* When centering the normal search bar, the bookmark search bar can go right on top of the normal one, and can move the bookmark button along with it to indicate that it is for searching for bookmarks visually.

issues.title: Reloading textures (F3+T) causes Astral sorcery custom recipes to not show in JEI (possibly other mods?)
issues.body:
Thank you for reporting!

For issues:
 * If the issue seems to affect only one mod, report to them instead of here.
 * Remove NEI and FEI to see if they are causing the issue before reporting.
 * If you crashed, please paste the crash log to [gist](https://gist.github.com/) and link it here.

For suggestions:
 * Please do not suggest features from NEI. [See this spreadsheet](https://goo.gl/MQ0f3R) before requesting.

Also posted to AS github here:
https://github.com/HellFirePvP/AstralSorcery/issues/1025

Basically if we run crafttweaker + jei + astral sorcery and add a custom recipe to its lightwell, crafting altar etc those recipe changes will show up fine but as soon as you reload textures in game with F3+T (or a mod does this like coop) the recipes will no longer show in JEI despite them still being valid recipes and working. Not sure if this issue is with JEI or Astral specifically but xposting for visibility. 

versions:
jei_1.12.2-4.15.0.268
Astral sorcery Jenkins build v82 (latest on his jenkins repo, although this also occurs with latest public stable release astralsorcery-1.12.2-1.10.12).
CraftTweaker2-1.12-4.1.15

issues.title: StackHelper uidCache still takes about 35 MB of heap space while ingame
issues.body:
Hi,
I'm doing some heap analysis on large packs right now and I saw that the uidCache still takes 33MB of space even though the comment says it should only be used during loading.
The cause for this seems that the array that backs IdentityHashMap stays at it's maximum size after clear, and so there is a huge array filled with nulls staying around.

issues.title: [Suggestion] Search for item name color and shift tooltip
issues.body:
Item colors often code for the importance of an item, so searching for eg. all orange-named items from botania would only show relics (`@bot §orange`) and searching for `-§white` would show all items in the modpack with highlighted names.
Likewise, searching for shift tooltips would allow you to select botania relics, but also to eg. search for tinkers construct materials with a mining level of cobalt (`pick head ##cobalt @tin`) or a durability between 1000 and 2000 (by searching for `pick head ##1, @tin`)

issues.title: [Feature Request] Config option for specifying a min width of the JEI overlays
issues.body:
As the title says, add an config option for specifying a minimum width of the JEI overlays (bookmarks and especially ingredients list).

Version 4.9.1.180 of JEI introduced a feature that always shows the button with wrench icon to inform user when JEI overlays are hidden, or when there is not enough space to display them. Its side effect is that it's now impossible to use JEI overlays on my PC with 1280×1024 screen (and probably others with "square" proportions) and "Auto" GUI scaling.

That's how it looks like on that 1280×1024 screen:
![ingredient-list-jei](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/34160838/51994445-0ef10a80-24b1-11e9-99c4-8e7a91a6636f.png)

I know that having 3-column list is not the most convenient thing, but in combination with the search bar it was useful enough.

issues.title: jei Bookmarks Overlapping AE
issues.body:
version: 4.1.4.1.235

I tried normal, large, auto, 4x, 5x etc, same issue. Seems to just need to take up less of a % of the left aligned portion of the screen? Just needs to back off 1 to 2 items.

This wouldn't be a big issue for me except that the bookmarks are taking priority over the AE buttons that are used far more.

issues.body:
I am trying to use ItemStages to stage enchanting books. When staging enchantment books, the books end up staged but continue to show in JEI even with all stages cleared. This originally worked (SevTech 3.0.8 hides them perfectly fine), but attempting to update to the newer versions of JEI cause this issue.

I'm lead to believe this is caused by a change in JEI. I've enabled debug logging for JEI and in the debug log it shows
```
[20:21:23] [main/DEBUG] [jei]: Removed ingredient: 1xitem.enchantedBook@0 minecraft:enchanted_book nbt:{StoredEnchantments:[{lvl:1s,id:0s}]}
```

I've noticed that compared to 4.13.1.223, 4.14.4.264 does not allow me to blacklist individual items from JEI if they are a variant with NBT - it blacklists all of that item instead of just that NBT tag specifically. Is this possibly caused by the same reason, and is this behaviour intentional?

Reference: https://github.com/Darkhax-Minecraft/ItemStages/issues/42

#### Versions:
Previous JEI: 4.13.1.223
New JEI: 4.14.4.264
ItemStages: 2.0.46

issues.title: Loading times incredibly slow on high resolution
issues.body:
I've been having issues on my laptop with JEI taking excessively high amounts of time to load (particularly the "Indexing Ingredients" stage, which has taken over 20 minutes before). My laptop has 16GB of RAM and a 7th gen i7 processor, so it's not starved of power in any sense. My desktop with the same specs but a faster i7 loads much faster.

I decided to randomly try dragging the window down to a small size and loading MC again, instead of letting MultiMC maximize it, and the "indexing ingredients" phase completed in a matter of seconds.

My laptop has a 4K screen, so the maximized resolution is pretty large. My somewhat-educated guess is that each call from JEI to update the loading screen (it seems every item is logged on the progress bar) is blocked while the screen updates. The root cause of this might be in FML, but it could probably be rectified by JEI as well by logging progress at a more coarse level (by mod, perhaps).

issues.title: FPS drop with some mods
issues.body:
Hi,

I have huge FPS drops from over 70 to low 40s and even as low as
20s. I run Stone Block 1.0.31. 

These mods make my FPS drop below 30:
- Immersive Engineering 
- Refined Storage
- Open Blocks
- Chisel
- Mekanism ,

but there are many more that lower FPS, as said before, to 40s.

Forge : 14.23.5.2768
JEI : 4.13.1.255

Problem was also existing with applied energistics 2 covers, but
was some what fixed with branch fix-3810-3813 (not as much drop as before,
but still existing).

issues.title: [1.12.2] JEI Tooltip Oddity?
issues.body:
Minecraft: 1.12.2
Forge: 14.23.5.2795

Mods: 1+
*jei_1.12.2-4.14.0.229*

-----

Unsure if this is intended but before... you can view special tooltips on certain items such as Spice of Life: Carrot Edition's 'Not eaten yet' tooltips on food-items as well as Tinker's Construct items displaying different info in the JEI Menu... however in the JEI version that I'm using... apparently that special info isn't displaying.

![](https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/377171551155650560/520187167096569856/jeitooltipoddness.PNG)
Here's an image with Tinker's Contruct's as well as Spice of Life: Carrot Edition. The info in the JEI Menu either doesn't show special tooltips or it shows some other info... yet when those items are in my inventory the tooltip shows as well as other info being displayed.

![](https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/377171551155650560/520189068655722496/jeiiteminfoduringpause.PNG)
One more thing to note... you can view the JEI Menu while the game is paused... which... I don't think that's suppose to happen. If Cheats are enabled you can even spawn items while the game is paused.

-----

The version I was using before updating was 'jei_1.12.2-4.13.0.219' and it showed the tooltip info fine in the JEI Menu, also you couldn't spawn items while the game was paused, as seen in this image.
![](https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/377171551155650560/520190480739205131/tooltipinfooldjei.PNG)

issues.title: Center search bar not centered after toggling overlay

2. open inventory to see the JEI overlay
3. Press O to disable the JEI overlay
4. Close inventory
5. Open inventory again.
 Now the little wrench icon is in the bottom right corner and not centered. If you now enable the JEI overlay again the search bar is still in the bottom right corner.

If you now close and open the inventory again its back in the center.

issues.title: [Suggestion] Save recipe button
issues.body: I was thinking it might be really nice to have a {Save} button on the recipe screen to save the recipe to the left side of the window.  Then you could have a list of recipes on the left that you are aiming towards, with the full list on the right. I realize there is a bind-able key to view previous recipe, but often the goal machine I'm aiming to make is 2-7 recipes away from the beginning parts I'm currently making. This would also be very nice in creating a visible to-do list as I am often distracted and forget what I'm working on with so many projects going on at once.

issues.title: Recipe registry plugin lagging
issues.body:
I'm running JEI in the Stoneblock modpack with ~7GiB allocated to minecraft, about 1GiB of which is kept in swap on an SSD during normal operation. I've noticed a recurrent problem wherein using the JEI search bar or loading some crafting recipes sometimes causes a severe drop in framerate, even after the search is complete.
A quick glance at the log showed this message:
`[01:18:49] [main/WARN] [jei]: Recipe registry plugin is slow, took 134.7 ms. class mezz.jei.recipes.InternalRecipeRegistryPlugin
`
I just confirmed my suspicion that vanilla items do not have this problem, so I suspect the problem is that a large recipe list is stored as a linked list of some variety internally, requiring excessive pointer chasing to access the later items of the list, but not earlier items in the list (ie: vanilla iron bars).

Also probably related to #1356.

Writing this after midnight so not really sure, but probably could fix by grouping recipes into arrays rather than having a list node for each one, or increasing the array size if this is already done. I haven't looked at the code because midnight, but I'll try and give it a glance tomorrow.

issues.title: Specificity in IModRegistry#handleRecipes
issues.body:
I have a recipe type that extends ShapelessRecipes, and adds one additional piece of data.  Since it extends ShapelessRecipes, it's automatically handled by the vanilla plugin.  Unfortunately, I can't override that by registering my own handler for it.

It would be useful for JEI to send recipes to the **most specific** handler for that recipe class.

e.g.:
```
registry.handleRecipes(ShapelessRecipes.class, ...);
registry.handleRecipes(MyShapelessRecipes.class, ...);
```

If I view a MyShapelessRecipe, I would expect it to be matched by the handler for MyShapelessRecipe, even though it technically matches both.
