issues.title: [Suggestion] More consistent tooltip placement when hovering items in the list
issues.body:
Currently, the tooltip prefers to expand to the right side of the cursor when hovering over items; however, if the item is near the edge of the screen, and any given line inf the tooltip is sufficiently long, the tooltip will flip and expand to the left of the cursor.

This is a little annoying when scanning through similar items looking for difference in stats (tinker's parts or sky resources casings, for example).

Could an option be added - or possibly changed at a basic level - to have the tooltip drawn more consistently? That is to say, if the cursor is on the right half of the screen (i.e. the normal, default position of the JEI list), always expand the tooltip to the left. If the cursor is on the left half of the screen (this may not even possible, I don't know if JEI has an option to "flip" which side of the screen the item list is displayed), expand the tootlip to the right. This will allow tooltips to display more consistently and saves having to check whether the length of text in the tooltip would expand off the screen. (This assumes the tooltip information is coded in JEI and not provided by forge.)

issues.title: API suggestion - a way to get the hovered item in recipe GUI
issues.body:
I was looking for a way to get the currently hovered item from the recipe GUI. Sadly, [the IRecipesGui interface](mezz/JustEnoughItems/blob/f5acb392ccdbc5ed8b6de6181f30bf0e42442957/src/api/java/mezz/jei/api/IRecipesGui.java), the only interface in the public API that the recipe GUI implements, does not have a way to get the currently hovered item like the [IIngredientListOverlay](https://github.com/mezz/JustEnoughItems/blob/f5acb392ccdbc5ed8b6de6181f30bf0e42442957/src/api/java/mezz/jei/api/IIngredientListOverlay.java#L19) does. 
This is definitely possible if I use JEI internals, but that might not work at all in a few versions.

*Use case*: I reimplemented Botania's Corporea request keybind (press a button when hovering over and item to request it from a nearby Corporea Index, see Vazkii/Botania#2668), but sadly this can't be used when in the recipe GUI. I was thinking about this when making that PR, but I only decided I really want it when I actually made use of this feature in a playthrough and couldn't request some crafting ingredients easily.

issues.title: Mismatching Enchantment Names in recipe and the JEI item list
issues.body:
JEI version：1.12.2-4.11.0.212

This issue occurred when adding/removing a mod that contained enchantments into an existing world, in other words, creating a new world won't have this issue.

After adding a new mod that contained enchantments to the existing world I was playing, the enchantment names in the item list won't be the same as the names in the usage GUI, despite having a correct recipe(if ignore the names).

For example, when I left-click the enchantment Gills（an enchantment for helmets only） in JEI item list,
![2018-08-26_20 37 59](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/3255986/44628432-3aa41d80-a972-11e8-8408-ba85bd84424a.png)
the GUI will show a correct recipe but the enchantment name is not Gills but bloodlust(an enchantment for swords only). Continually, if I left-click the bloodlust here,
![2018-08-26_20 38 05](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/3255986/44628465-af775780-a972-11e8-8207-de52b8bd8f01.png)
I will arrive at bloodlust's recipe correctly but again, the name of the enchanted book in the recipe is another enchantment Arrowstorm( which is an enchantment for bows only).
![2018-08-26_20 38 27](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/3255986/44628508-6a075a00-a973-11e8-8035-33cf59d74c89.png)

It seems that adding/removing a mod involved enchantments into an existing world would mess up the enchantment IDs or names somehow. 
Is it possible to rebuild the enchantment IDs based on neutral section(for example, the main menu section) when entering an existing world? Or maybe use the enchantment IDs from the main menu section to override the messed up existing world IDs? Or maybe use the IDs from an new world with same modlist to update the IDs in the existing world? 
I don't know much about coding for MC, these are just brainstorming.
Hope you guys could come up with solution for this issue.

issues.title: [Suggestion] JEI Tabs
issues.body: Minecraft's creative menu would be a mess to navigate without the tabs. JEI should have a "tabs" feature to assist in the player's navigation. Ideally, these could be configured by the modpack maker. Please consider this necessary feature.

* Minecraft Forge 14.23.4.2732
* Just Enough Items (JEI) 4.11.0.202
* Additional Mods
  * CraftTweaker 4.1.9.486 (Tested w/ 4.1.9 - public release)

### Issue Description

I was attempting to remove all AE2 Facades from JEI. The simplest way for me to do this was through CraftTweaker, as I wanted to keep at least one facade and add a tooltip to it as well as a JEI description). However, upon restarting the game and loading up a world, I did not find the facade I had added in after removing them all in JEI.

To ensure that this wasn't an issue with other mods or NBT data I decided to attempt it in an instance with the two mods listed above and instead of removing facades I just used stone (The example I used can be found of the CraftTweaker documentation page [here](http://crafttweaker.readthedocs.io/en/latest/#Mods/JEI/JEI/).)

However, after multiple attempts and trying various tweaks and ordering of the script I was still unable to get this to work. 

My first thought was to speak with the author of CraftTweaker, @jaredlll08. After speaking to Jared about the issue and having him try a few things (hence the custom build from his build server being used) I still wasn't able to get the item to be removed then re-added.

Jared seems to think that the issue here is:
> "Hiding items at runtime is done after adding items at runtime, causing custom items to be hidden"

Personally, I cannot really know how or what is causing the issue however it's definitely something I feel should be resolved as without it would be disappointing as there are a lot of use cases for this sort of feature.

### Steps to Reproduce the Issue

In order to reproduce this issue, create a Minecraft 1.12.2 instance with Forge 14.23.4.2732 installed. Be sure to also add JEI and CraftTweaker to the mods folder and leave configurations at default. (Builds for both mods can be found on CurseForge.)

1. Launch the game once after environment setup and then close it down once you reach the main menu.
2. Open up the instance directory, navigate to the scripts directory and create a new file called script.zs.
3. Proceed to open the said file in your favourite text editor.
4. Copy and paste the first code snippet listed below into this script, save and close the script.
5. Load up the game and create a singleplayer world
6. Once in-game, open up the inventory and look through JEI for the item. You'll see that the item isn't listed anywhere.
7. Now going back to your instance directory you can check both the `crafttweaker.log` and `logs/latest.log`. In the CraftTweaker log you'll notice the statements in the script are being executed in the correct order. However, if you then proceed to check the `latest.log` you'll notice that the statements are reversed - it adds then removes the items. Meaning that the item you're adding is being added. However, it is then removed again. 

*** 

Code snippet to add to script for instruction 4 above. (This example is taken directly from the CraftTweaker documentation.) 

```
mods.jei.JEI.hide(<minecraft:stone>);
mods.jei.JEI.addItem(<minecraft:stone>.withTag({display:{Name: "Pickle",Lore:["What once was stone", "Is stone no more"]}}));
```

### Issue Attachments

I've enclosed copies of both my logs and my script file via pastebin.com links below.

* [crafttweaker.log](https://pastebin.com/Z6yktz1D) - ln6-7
* [latest.log](https://pastebin.com/erJ6rbJL) - ln85-86

issues.title: Can't hide only one AE2 facade in latest version
issues.body:
Up until the latest update this worked smoothly, so I assume it's related to the recent fix to issue #195. When item hiding mode is enabled, pressing ctrl + left click works fine on most items. That single item would get a yellow background. This works fine with most items with NBT data, including enchanted books.

When doing the same thing to a single AE2 facade, every single facade gets the same yellow background. I'm not right clicking and it doesn't have a red background, so I'm not using the "hide by category" option.

I've specifically tested this with only JEI and AE2 installed to rule out other mod interactions. I have noticed the same effect with Forge Multiparts, Gendustry bee samples, and Immersive Railroading components, but I haven't performed the same tests with these.

It's not affecting all items that only differ by NBT data, however. Tinkers' tools and enchanted books works exactly as intended.

issues.body:
I'm not sure if this falls in the domain of JEI or ItemStages.

Cross posted from: https://github.com/Darkhax-Minecraft/ItemStages/issues/20

### What

When I log into a new world with zero stages unlocked, most, but not all, staged recipe catalysts are hidden by JEI properly. Hiding recipe categories when all their crafting catalysts are hidden was introduced in JEI v4.9.0.

I am able to consistently reproduce this issue with the HorsePower mod's `<horsepower:chopper>`. When I log in with zero stages unlocked, the catalyst remains visible:

issues.title: java.lang.UnsupportedOperationException: Calling old getTooltip is not supported.
issues.body:
Hi,

I'm posting this issue on behalf of a friend, who despite having the exact same set of mods as I is running into a crash directly involving JEI. I've got them to try both the release and beta versions of the mod for 1.12.2, to no avail. The issue in question appears to involve the mod attempting to call an outdated method.

- Their latest.log: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1DkqPKuV80M4LErAXnF3w5rVT76kcsiiN
- Their crash report: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1wo5Nv2FM5hGRwzDw85dePE68aWu_QBA3

Unfortunately the text is too big for pastebin, and I don't know how to use gist, so hopefully this will suffice.

issues.title: Wiki page should be updated
issues.body:
At https://github.com/mezz/JustEnoughItems/wiki/Creating-Plugins , there is this tip:
```Tip: Your plugin can extend BlankModPlugin, so it can override only the sections it needs.```
But in API BlankModPlugin is deprecated, and it's not needed at all because IModPlugin has default impl. of methods.

issues.title: Problem with searching for ore dictionary tags added to items by crafttweaker.
issues.body:
Forge: 14.23.3.2678
Crafttweaker: 4.1.8
JEI: 4.9.1.173

Overall description of issue:
While working on my modpack, I discovered that I was unable to use the JEI ore dictionary search to find items by searching for their ore dictionary tag, if that tag was one I was adding with crafttweaker. However, I was still able to search for items by their ore dictionary tag if it was one that they had "naturally".

I tried out an instance of minecraft with just Forge, JEI, and Crafttweaker, and couldn't get the issue to reproduce. That is, until **after restarting my minecraft client**. Suddenly, I couldn't find the oredictionary tag I had added to cobblestone again.

Even **more** curious to me, was, that deleting JEI's config folder (``\config\jei``) and starting the client again seemed to fix the issue, that is, until the next time I restarted my client, at which point searching for the ore dictionary tag I had added proved fruitless again.

Steps to reproduce:
* Create a new instance with just JEI and Crafttweaker (versions listed at top).
* Don't start minecraft yet!
* Put the following super rad script into a ``\scripts\`` folder and save it as a text file named ``anything.zs``:
```
<ore:testStoneDictThing>.add(<minecraft:cobblestone>);
```
* NOW start minecraft.
* Go into JEI's configuration menu (the little wrench :3) and go to ``search options`` and set ``$OreDictionary`` to ``require_prefix``.
* Click done and done, and type ``$test`` into the JEI text search box.
* The game should show you cobblestone!
* Save, quit, and exit the game.
* Restart Minecraft.
* Reopen your world.
* Type ``$test`` into the search box again. The game will NOT show you cobblestone, because it is mad.
* Angrily save, quit, and exit the game, and delete the ``\config\jei`` folder in a fit of rage.
* Restart minecraft one last time, to see how JEI feels about that.
* Open your world, type ``$test`` into the search bar.
* JEI is happy to show you cobblestone again! Forgiveness and friendship abound... ``u n t i l t h e n e x t c l i e n t r e s t a r t . . .``

Thankyou for your time, and probably for your patience with my verbosity. The best to you.

Would it be possible to add a toggle for the crafting book takeover? Thank you.

issues.title: Add option to show all recipes, regardless of hidden catalysts
issues.body:
### What

I would like the option to temporarily disable the feature introduced in commit 156f46ed2be24d7f9d36bf515ded4d776fd223d7: `Hide recipe categories when all their crafting catalysts are hidden`.

### Why

I think that this feature is a good addition to JEI and I support it, however, it has greatly impeded my workflow. I am working on a pack with more than fifty non-linear stages using mods such as GameStages, ItemStages, and RecipeStages. While working on this project, I have come to rely on JEI as the powerful recipe browsing tool it is. With the introduction of this new feature, I am no longer able to view all recipes without unlocking all stages first. I would love to be able to temporarily disable this feature, possibly with a config option, and once again have a complete recipe catalog at my fingertips during development.

issues.title: Modded Enchanted Books Shuffled / Incorrect
issues.body:
# Versions

Forge: 14.23.3.2655
JEI: 4.9.1.168
Full modlist: https://pastebin.com/7mM64ZDY

issues.title: Add callbacks to inventories when user searches
issues.body:
Please add a callback to the GuiTextFieldFilter.java class so that when the user opens an inventory, the inventory can ask for callbacks when the user searches for something in JEI.
This might be something like adding a new method on JeiHelpers.java that reaches down to the text field to add a callback to an internal list of callbacks. When an inventory is opened it is the burden is on the inventory to call into jei and provide a keypress callback method.

This would allow the inventory to highlight items that the user searches for in JEI.
This may already be done with ME systems, though it may be the reverse (whatever the user searches for in the ME system search field then JEI updates). 
An ActuallyAdditions Crate, for example, may want to let the user search for an item, and would love to use the existing JEI search field on the screen.  
The RFTools modular storage has a search field, as well as the 2 big contenders for ME systems (applied energistics, and Refined Storage), but the lowly Tinker's Construct + Storage Crate pair are missing out when it comes to casting accio thingamajigger.
If the other 3 big ME systems integrated with this new API, then moving the search bar to the center just became much more appealing and a one stop shop.

issues.title: [Enhancement Request] Client-option to hide crafting recipe tabs
issues.body:
I don't know if this is even a JEI-thing or not, I'm only assuming that it is. Apologies if it's not.

If a part of JEI, I'm suggest enabling a client-side option to hide crafting tabs (the ones that let you see crafts by machine-type, at the very top of the JEI window) as some machines are not well integrated into JEI and appear multiple times and serve absolutely no purpose other than bogging down the window making it frustrating to use as you have to click the next-button so many times to get past these annoying repetitive machines. Please see screenshot of one example:

![2018-03-09_15 27 06](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/5846389/37243436-8f1f07fe-2479-11e8-96be-32e1019e24c5.png)
In the screenshot this so called "Void Resource Miner" appears 6 times. The information below (two pipes, a block and percentages) is literal the only information shown on the JEI page. The only difference between the pages are the percentages... They obviously could have implemented a smoother way to show their recipes but this method just drown the JEI interface. When reloading resources during runtime (i.e changing mipmap levels, applying a resource pack, pressing F3+T...) the item blacklist is not re-applied, and all previously hidden items are displayed in JEI until the game is restarted or the item hiding mode is enabled then disabled via the in-game config. issues.title: [1.12.2] [4.8.5.150] Recipe transfer implementation issue
issues.body:
MC: 1.12.2
Forge: 14.23.1.2601
JEI: 4.8.5.150

**What happens:**
When hovering the recipe transfer button with the appropriate items in the inventory, the missing items message is displayed.

**Description:**
I am having an issue with recipe transfer implementation in my mod. I'm trying to get this sorted and I'd like to know if I'm doing something wrong.

`<ore:logWood>` is provided by a CraftTweaker ZenScript file and is converted to a list of `ItemStack`, in one case, by calling `getOres()` on the `OreDictionary` class and in another case, by calling `Ingredient#getMatchingStacks()`. The conversion takes place inside the constructor of my `IRecipeWrapper` implementation and both return the same results: a list with two `ItemStack` - `minecraft:log:32767` and `minecraft:log2:32767`.

That list is added to the `IIngredients` object passed into my `IRecipeWrapper#getIngredients()` implementation. The ingredients are displayed as expected when viewing the recipe in JEI and all the ingredients cycle through as expected. However, when hovering the button to transfer items to the crafting grid, the missing items message is displayed.

I've traced the path to this point in the stack:

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1240716/35950708-b0a1ec6c-0c2c-11e8-9718-e25788bc7ecb.png)

... and in the call to `StackHelper#isEquivalent()` I noticed that it was not matching the unique identifiers for each stack, even though one has a wildcard value of `32767`.

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1240716/35949733-dcce20f8-0c27-11e8-8d7d-c11de7f1ff76.png)

I've noticed that this happens with both `<ore:logWood>` and `<ore:plankWood>`.

I tested both ore dictionary values using CraftTweaker and the vanilla crafting table and JEI handles it just fine. This leads me to believe that the fault lies in my implementation, but for the life of me, I can't discern where the failure is located.

I also noticed that in the vanilla crafting table, when hovering an ore dictionary ingredient in the recipe display, the line `Accepts any: logWood` is displayed in the tooltip. This line is not displayed when hovering the ore dictionary ingredients, `<ore:logWood>` or `<ore:plankWood>` in my implementation. Other ore dictionary ingredients display and behave properly. I would venture a guess that it is just the ore dictionary ingredients that return an `ItemStack` with a wildcard value that are problematic.

Any insight into this issue would be greatly appreciated. If I can provide any more information or assistance, please advise. Thank you for your time!

![issue](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1240716/35951113-cdce045e-0c2e-11e8-89f4-ee077a2b62da.gif)

issues.title: [1.10-1.11] Recipes are not removing / adding correctly
issues.body:
So I have recently been using MineTweaker to adjust some recipes for a particular mod. And I know you said that if there is an issue, to report it to them and I did. They did some searching and the error only occurs on 1.10-1.11 versions of their mod. The issue is as follows:

For the NuclearCraft mod, I am trying to remove the recipes for graphite dust but unfortunately they do not get removed from JEI. They are however removed from the machine (as I can no longer get graphite dust from the machine). Every time I reloaded MineTweaker using `/mt reload` it added all of the graphite recipes again to JEI instead of removing them. I tried to reload the game and when I looked in JEI, the recipes were still there (although they were removed from the machine).

Now from the mod author's own investigations, this does not occur in the 1.12 version (due to the change in recipes (as they now take `.json` instead of `GameRegistry.addRecipe`)). I'm not sure if there is a way this can be fixed, but if so, that would be amazing.

issues.title: JEI is not reading actual item name after resource reload
issues.body:
I discovered this while translating Forestry and I have clear guide how to reproduce this with minimal mod setup (I'm 99% sure this should be same with only Forge and JEI). It affects vanilla items too.

How to reproduce:
1) Start game go into the world, change language to any from English (supported by Forestry)
2) Shut down game, start again, change language back to English (before going into the world) and go into the world.
3) Type "mead" for example in JEI search and you'll find only meadows hive
4) Try type mead in language you used in past (if it's Russian it is "мёд") (which I used in test)
5) You will find mead-related stuff actually in English but you can't search for them in English (The actual names are in English but you only can find them using Russian translated string)
6) Shut down game, start and go into the world. Type mead and everything settled.
As I originally wanted to report it to Forestry I used Forestry items.

Using vanilla items:

1. Start game go into the world, change language to any from English (In my example Russian)
2) Shut down game, start again, change language back to English (before going into the world) and go into the world.
3) Type "Stone" for example in JEI search and you'll find nothing
4) Try type stone in language you used in past (if it's Russian it is "Камень") (You can just copy it from here)
5) You will find stone-related stuff actually in English but you can't search for them in English (The actual names are in English but you only can find them using Russian translated string)
6) Shut down game, start and go into the world. Type Stone and everything settled.

It also affects Tcon so I guess it affects everything, search in creative tab working as intended.
Forge used: 2587, java 8 u151
Mods used: https://i.imgur.com/rxp6dWG.png

issues.title: Allow crafting blocks to overlay buttons on ItemStacks in recipe
issues.body:
Proposal: 
IRecipeTransferHandler or something similar should allow a container to place small clickable status icons on top of ItemStacks of arbitrary IRecipeCategory recipes. 

Reasoning: 
Refined Storage (https://github.com/raoulvdberge/refinedstorage) has a neat feature where you can teach it to craft items and dependencies on demand, even for arbitrary IRecipeCategory recipes. This involves a confirmation dialog to inform/remind the user which items will be consumed in the crafting.  Unfortunately, this means "does the container/player have this item" for IRecipeTransferHandler is not a boolean. Some items are available, some are not available, and some are craftable. To sidestep this issue, raoulvdberge has simply made RecipeTransferHandlerGrid never return an error, which makes the recipes tricky to use.  
It would be much clearer if IRecipeTransferHandler.transferRecipe could return a IRecipeTransferError for craftable items, and show a "craftable" status icon for these stacks. Upon clicking this icon, Refined Storage should show the crafting confirmation dialog, then start crafting, and animate the status icon. When the crafting is complete, the status icon should go away. RecipeTransferErrorSlots is _almost_ powerful enough already, except it's only shown when RecipeTransferButton is hovered over, rather than all of the time.

issues.title: Dupe bug with Ctrl+Click
issues.body:
Playing current (20171012) ver of FTB Beyond 1.10
MCP 9.19
FML 8.0.99.99
Forge 12.18.3.2422
ActuallyAdditions 1.10.2-r105
JEI 3.14.7.419
InvTweaks 1.61-58-a1fd884

Normal operation:

    Using Ctrl+Click on a vanilla inventory will transfer 1 item from a stack to/from the player's inventory.
    Ctrl+LeftClick drops the 1 item on an existing stack in the destination inventory.
    Ctrl+RightClick creates a new stack for each 1 item transferred.
    If Ctrl+Clicking with no GUI open, it will transfer 1 item between the hotbar and the player's main inventory.

Ctrl+Clicking with an AA machine GUI open (tested with Farmer, Canola Press and Coal Gen) results in JEI's spawn item functionality being triggered (even though spawn mode is currently disabled).

    A Ctrl+RightClick spawns a single item.
    A Crtl+LeftClick spawns the difference between the partial stack being clicked, and the max stack size.
    Tested with coal and canola.

Originally, I discovered this with ActuallyAdditions machines. Just now, I have also gotten this result when trying to Ctrl-Click a TiCo hammer into the Tool Forge. x-posting to InvTweaks Git.

Cheers!

issues.title: Show a screen even if there's no recipes or usages
issues.body:
Currently, if you left-click an item that has no recipes, or right-click an item that isn't used for anything, nothing at all happens. You remain in either the inventory, or in the last recipe that you happened to be looking at. I propose that a mostly-blank screen be opened instead. Two reasons for this:
1. When looking through all of a mod's items, it would make it more obvious which ones have recipes and which ones don't. Currently, if similar-looking items have similar recipes, it can be easy to miss the fact that one didn't have a recipe at all.
2. It would make the plus sign button usable for all items, which would allow adding uncraftable items to other mods' virtual item filter lists without actually needing to have said item.

issues.title: Gated Recipes.
issues.body:
Hey Mezz,

Would it be possible to tie into Vanilla's restricted crafting gamerule in order to gate / hide recipes in JEI if mods supported it correctly?

I've recently started playing modded Minecraft again with friends who have only played vanilla, and they very very quickly were overwhelmed by all the possible items that could be crafted.

I'd love to lower the barrier of entry into crafting with modpacks, but at current with the current mod pack designs literally none of them over the years (barring a few exceptions, that have books, or hard core quest modes made for them that show the recipe) have made their beginnings easily accessible to new-to-modding players.

I'd love to share the joy of modded minecraft with these players, without them having to trawl through getting started wiki pages like we all did when we started.

What do you say? Possible?

issues.title: Suggestion involving vanilla crafting guide
issues.body:
Having JEI installed renders the vanilla crafting guide obsolete. Because of this, I have a suggestion, although as someone who isn't familiar with programming I'm not sure how feasible this is to do.
JEI should remove the vanilla crafting guide but keep the book icon in the inventory. The book icon can be clicked to toggle JEI on and off. This way, JEI acts as a full, polished replacement to the vanilla crafting guide.

issues.title: [1.12] itemKey for nbt items (registered to AllNbt interpreter) doesn't account for meta
issues.body:
I saw that some of my items disappeared from JEI and debugging this figured out that the issue was introduced with https://github.com/mezz/JustEnoughItems/commit/251bd0a62883c3a0a3fdf264e163665c719fdf72 
Basically the AllNbt interpreter would previously return null which triggered logic in StackHelper that added metadata to the itemKey, but as it now returns ISubtypeInterpreter.NONE (aka emptry string) the meta logic is no longer triggered and thus subItems with different meta, but same nbt are ignored.

mezz, not sure if this was intentional and actually looking at the logic that I "fixed" in the past it wouldn't work even previously if subitem had the same nbt as another, but meta was different (it would display just the first one it came over). 

I am happy to submit PR, just need to understand if registering to this subtype interpreter should consider meta as well or if in that case mods need to write their own. Or perhaps if there should be another one in JEI (AllMetaNbt).

issues.title: Expose returned items in crafting recipes
issues.body: Some crafting recipes return items to the input side of the crafting table. For example, the recipe for a cake returns empty buckets, and the recipe for copying a written book returns the original book. These returned items are currently neither visible nor searchable in JEI, though. Could this feature be added?

issues.title: ColorNamer API
issues.body:
It would be nice to have an API to access ColorNamer instead of having to use the Internal class.

Use case: I'm implementing a JEI-like search system and want to leverage JEI's color system if available.

I would prefer to use JEI's search system itself, but I figure a much easier goal is to just expose color names in the API. As it stands, there's API to get a list of colors, but not a list of color *names*.

issues.title: [Suggestion]Advanced JEI GUI scaling
issues.body:
I assume JEI GUI size and Minecraft GUI size settings are heavily related. But would it still be possible to give the user some more controll over the size of the list entries ? I am running a 16:9 monitor and with my most available Minecraft GUI Settings their are just to many entries on the same page and to small icons. Which makes it hard to find certain items without using the search bar and literally typing it out. I would love to be able to define the amount of items per row and the amount of colums and change the size of the item icons if possible.
If I can implement this myself and you can show me how I would gladly do so. :)

issues.title: [Suggestion]Advanced Search Filter with profiles
issues.body:
It would be nice to have the ability to hide certain mods from the list without the use of the search bar.
For example as a user I would love to be able to hide all those chisel entries to just one per block. Or just hide certain items that I know I don't need to look up, so it's easier to actually find what I am looking for. Having the options to save those list of hidden items(in profiles) could be really handy.
If I can implement this myself and you can show me how I would gladly do so. :)

issues.title: Oredict recipes with no matching items show up with blank spots
issues.body:
**Setup:** Create a recipe that uses the ore dictionary, but with no items that match the ore dictionary key. For example, in CraftTweaker:
```
recipes.addShapeless(<minecraft:clay_ball>, [<minecraft:water_bucket>, <ore:nonexistium>]);
```

**Expected Behavior:** The recipe doesn't show up at all in JEI, since it's impossible to actually use.

**Observed Behavior:** The recipe shows up in JEI, but completely missing any sign of the item corresponding to the empty oredict key. (In the example above, you see a recipe of just a water bucket becoming clay, which won't actually work if you try it.)

**Other Notes:**
JEI version 4.7.8.92. Note that this happens with any mod that adds such a recipe, not just CraftTweaker.

issues.body:
Either I`am overlooking a option for this , or its a missing feature.
I like to frequently hide the jei item panel to reduce lag when going in my inv, tough it always reappears after reentering my inv
Also before actully hiding the panel it lets the options button appear at the first buton press

issues.title: API request: get recipe category in recipe layout
issues.body:
Hi,

The problem is I'm trying to get crafting item when using a custom universal recipe transfer handler.  Is there any related API that I have missed?

My old solution is using diffent transfer handlers for each recipe category, but it seems a little wired since I'm doing universal transfer, and it requires some extra work to get the category list.

I noticed JEI is storing the recipe category in recipe layout, so is it possible to provide API to get it? I don't know much about JEI's design, what I'm looking forward to is exposing information about recipe category to universal recipe transfer handlers.

issues.title: [1.12] [Feature request] Hide items with no recipes/no unlocked recipes.
issues.body:
Obviously, this would have to be a config option, one that I feel would allow JEI to work with Minecraft's built in Recipe Book much better. First of all, the behavior changes:

- Items with no recipes are automatically hidden
- For items with recipes, the mod would check the following conditions. If all are met, the item is hidden.  
  - The item has no unlocked recipes
  - The item's recipes are able to be unlocked in some way (Check advancements to see if the recipe is a reward for any)
  - The item has no other recipe types (If it has furnace, brewing, etc., the item should be shown, but not the crafting recipe if the above 2 conditions are met)

This would of course be configurable, these are the config options I suggest:

- Hide items with no recipe
- Hide recipes that haven't been unlocked

EDIT: Another related idea that could probably be done at the same time: Only show items whose recipes use items from the current inventory as ingredients.

issues.title: Feature Request: Custom Items Tags and Folders
issues.body:
Heya Mezz,

Feature request for pack devs and players: 

Allow players and pack creators to assign a "tag" to items to allow searching for those items easier. For example, I tag all pickaxes with the "Pickaxe" tab and I can see everything I designated into that category. It would make a world of difference to pack devs to easily work through items and not miss anything while developing and players would be able to tag notes on items for future ideas during gameplay. Possibly a "folder" type functionality to work with this, too. 

Personally, I find working through items one by one without missing something out of the hundreds, or even thousands, of items in the game a lot easier if I can tag them as "viewed". Adding new mods to a pack already in development would be easy since you can easily determine which items need to be looked over for balance/progression.

Thank you for you time!
Darkosto

issues.title: Recipe sorting question
issues.body:
Hi, got a question about how JEI sorts recipes (and whether I can influence the ordering of recipes added by my mod).

I add a recipe for each module item that my mod adds - see https://github.com/desht/ModularRouters/blob/master/src/main/java/me/desht/modularrouters/recipe/ModRecipes.java#L34 for that.  That's a regular vanilla crafting recipe, either shaped or shapeless (and some modules may use oredicted ingredients).

Later on, I also add some "enhancement" recipes, where a module item can be crafted with other ingredients to modify its behaviour in some way - https://github.com/desht/ModularRouters/blob/master/src/main/java/me/desht/modularrouters/recipe/ModRecipes.java#L74.  The enhancement recipes extend a custom ModuleEnhancementRecipe class, which handles validation, NBT copying, etc.

Note that these enhancements also have their own JEI recipe handlers, mainly for the purposes of adding an informative tooltip to the output item in the JEI recipe for that enhancement.  These handlers just use the vanilla crafting category (VanillaRecipeCategoryUid.CRAFTING).

The problem I have is that JEI always shows the enhancement recipes before the primary crafting recipe for the module, which is annoying, since the crafting recipe is used more often, and therefore you end up scrolling through potentially several enhancement recipes before you find the primary recipe.

Is there a way of telling JEI that the primary recipe should always be shown first?  I'd hoped the Forge RecipeSorter might have some effect (and my enhancement recipes have a RecipeSorter dependency
of "after:forge:shapelessore"), but apparently not.

issues.title: When removing oreDict entries using CraftTweaker, uses and tooltips are not updated
issues.body:
When you use CraftTweaker to remove an item from the ore dictionary, JEI does not fully update. The tooltip for the item still shows the ore dictionary entry. If you press 'U' to view the uses of the item, it will work as if the item is still added to the ore dictionary.

Reproduction steps:

-Create an instance with JEI, CraftTweaker and Botania (Vanilla doesn't use the ore dictionary)

-Create a script file with the following inside:

`val dyeWhite = <ore:dyeWhite>;`
`dyeWhite.remove(<botania:dye:0>);`

-Use the /mt reload command or restart your game

Press 'U' to view the uses of floral white powder. It will show you all of the uses of bonemeal, despite not being able to craft any of them.

When holding shift, it will still show dyeWhite in the tooltip.

issues.title: [Suggestion] More complete hiding of items in JEI
issues.body:
Preface:
Just spent four days moving up to MC1.10.2 (cracks knuckles) and I really enjoy JEI so thanks for the development and your time.  While adding/ removing mods and changing mod configs -- and quite a bit of hair pulling, I believe a feature enhancement of JEI could benefit all who like to customize.

Topic:
Using a combination of CraftTweaker (to remove a recipe) and JEI (to hide a item) is a powerful tool.  For most items you can play as if said item did not exist.  You cannot craft it, right clicking one of its ingredients will not show it in JEI (because recipe was removed) and it will not show up in JEI's list.  Perfect!  However, for more complicated items, such as a custom furnace, it can still show up in the JEI tabs by right clicking an item it can use -- such as coal for fuel.  I think these tabs should check to see if the item is blacklisted or not before showing.

EG: right click coal,
(JEI) I should show the tab for custom furnace because coal is a fuel for it.
(JEI) Is it blacklisted?  If so do not show tab.

Or, if that would be a huge hassle to add, even something simple like a new "tabs blacklist" config would be OK.  I can easily add entries myself manually.

Hope this is something you think is worth adding!

issues.title: JEI stops working after removing a mod
issues.body:
JEI stops working after removing a mod that the block is in the search history.

MC: `1.11.2`
JEI: `4.3.2.264`
Forge: `1.11.2-13.20.0.2282` or `1.11.2-13.20.0.2270` (I only tested with these versions)

How to reproduce:

- Install JEI
- Install any mod that adds blocks or items (I used extrautils 2)
- Searches for the block of mod and disable JEI (`CTRL+O`)
- Remove the mod

issues.title: JEI SessionData not updating when connecting to vanilla server
issues.body:
During testing of #807 I discovered that `checkModLists` is never called when connecting to a vanilla server. So if you go into SP first with a client having JEI installed and then connect to a vanilla server JEI will still think that it is installed on both sides. And will keep sending JEI packets to the sever which will never be processed since it is a vanilla server.

Proposed fix would be to use `ClientConnectedToServerEvent` to reset the state there, I don't know whether `checkModLists` is called before or after that, which might make it hard. Otherwise this might be something needing a patch in forge :/

issues.title: [API Feature] Allow black listing of ingredients in recipes
issues.body:
**Preface**
At the moment, JEI allows mod developers, through it's API, to remove ingredients from the ingredients list, but those ingredients then show up in recipes.

**The Problem**
Some mods, such as my own [Randores](https://github.com/SocraticPhoenix/Randores), may need to remove some ingredients from recipes. Specifically, in my mod, different items are created for each world. Some items can then be used in crafting recipes through the ore dictionary. However, some of the created items should not be used in recipes, though they are still registered in the ore dictionary, they are unobtainable. Furthermore, which items are unobtainable depends on which world the player is in. As such, it is necessary to black list the unobtainable items from both the ingredients list and the recipes.

**The Solution**
Add an "ore dictionary ingredient" black list, which removes items from the ingredients. I am not sure exactly how this should be implemented, but I have created a solution in [a fork](https://github.com/SocraticPhoenix/JustEnoughItems/commit/a84705d3bb1d8c5b8bc203ce6d23c01790734691), which I have tested with my mod and verified that it works. I wanted to open this issue before submitting a pull request since I am unsure if my implementation is a valid one... I feel that the owner of the mod would probably be aware of an even better implementation than my own.

issues.title: Issues with JEIs Prefabrication system
issues.body:
I wish i could update the mod IC2Crop Plugin which creates a pre caclulate information about what combos are the best to get a Crop.
There is 1 big problem with JEI.
If i use JEIs System it would increase the World Load time by 1-15 seconds at minium conditions.
To give a example: in 1.7.10 i thread the caluclation and do not allow to access these recipes until the recipe list is finalized. Because its so many types to calculate.
Smallest calculation is: 38^2 = 1444 Possible Combos
Middel calculation is : 38^3 + 38^2 = 56316 Possible Combos
Biggest calculation is: 38^4 + 38^3 + 38^2  = 2141452 Possible Combos.
And that is Vanilla IC2 if other mods add something to it it will be bigger

It needs to create all possible combos and then on top of that prevents duplicates.
On top of that yes to give a accurate information i have to in some cases show all cases.
And if someone enables the biggest combo the Calculation would lag the game for quite some time...

JEI should add a optional way to register things later...

issues.title: Disappearing water bucket from dispenser!
issues.body:
I know what you are thinking, what could this have to do with your mod and that's a good question. Here are the steps I took to come to this conclusion.  I cleaned out all my mods and loading a vanilla Minecraft and started a new world.  I then set up  a dispenser with a water bucket inside it and triggered a redstone signal. The water came out as it should have. I applied the signal again to remove the water. This worked as it should. I did this three or four more times to make sure that all was good.

I closed out Minecraft and restarted this time with Forge and did the same steps as before. It worked fine. Repeating the restart method I added IC2 my biggest mod next and tested each mod until I found the mod that the water bucket disappeared. After loading JEI I ran the test as before but this time there was no water after the second time. Looking inside the dispenser the bucket was gone. This was the problem I was having in my world that started me looking into this. 

I closed down and removed JEI and started up again and reset the test. Once again the test was working as before.  I'm not just sure what else I could tell you. 

If you want you can email me and I will send my cell number if you want to tell more about this. I don't do good with writing.  I've just started writing mod for 1.10 and having lots of fun. mcbigboy@gmail.com

issues.title: Cheat Option for blocks of Liquid
issues.body:
I'm using both Mekanism and Refined Storage, and I would like to use the latter to store fluids from the former.  However, if I want to be able to select a specific fluid for Refined Storage to work with (import/export/count amount) I need to be able to take a bucket of that fluid and click with it on the appropriate inventory box to select, which will then fill with a ghost copy of that type of fluid and do whatever I tell it to with that type of fluid in its inventory.

The problem is that, with the exception of three of it's fluids, mechanism doesn't have buckets for the rest of its fluids.  I'm going to talk to both them and RS about this issue, but I was REALLY hoping that one possible solution (hack) would be to just cheat in a block of fluid like I used to be able to do way back in the day with TMI and try placing that into the appropriate box in RS.  Unfortunately, even in cheat mode, clicking on a fluid does not give you a block of that fluid, but instead directs you to all the recipes for that fluid.

Could you PLEASE include a special cheat option toggle to let cheat mode give you fluid blocks instead of recopies?!?  I think that this might be useful in other situations besides just this one.  If nothing else, I miss just being able to hold a block of lava in my hand, regardless of how impossible that should have been (or perhaps precisely because of it)!

issues.title: Suggestion for 1.10.2
issues.body:
I noticed that Recipe Buttons are bound  to gui classes.
I just made a gui system that shares 1 Gui Container Class for almost every machine/block and that means i can not register a button area without having to Reflection call myself into JEI to inject a custom class into it...      

It would be nice if you could make a Interface that allows you to validate the button for the gui itself.
(isValidForGui(T guiInstance)) or something like that.

issues.title: Forge won't Load JEI
issues.body: It's a simple problem. As of 1.11.2, forge is now enforcing lowercase modids, and JEI's ID is, well, JEI. Since that id is not all lowercase, forge now ignores JEI when loading.

issues.title: Cache Recipes and Plugins
issues.body:
Thank you for reporting!

For suggestions:
 * Please do not suggest features from NEI. [See this spreadsheet](https://goo.gl/MQ0f3R) before requesting.

For issues:
 * Try the latest version, it may have fixed the issue already.
 * If you have NEI or FEI installed, please try without it before reporting.
 * If you crashed, please paste the crash log to [gist](https://gist.github.com/) and link it here.

---------

Hey! As a person with a slower computer, joining servers can be a pain in the behind on larger packs (eg. Hermitpack), as JEI takes almost TEN seconds (aka 9922 ms) to reload plugins, and does so twice every time I join any server (not to mention reloading the recipes twice as well) making the server ultimately time me out almost every single time.

So, it would be nice if JEI, instead of reloading plugins and recipes every single time I attempt to join a server, reload them once every time I join a different server after game reload (eg. I start the game, it loads recipes/plugins, I join Server 1, it reloads it, I join Server 2 it reloads it, I join Server 1 or Server 2 _again_  and it _doesn't_ reload plugins and recipes, then if I were to reload my game it would start this cycle again, that way I would only time out from servers once, rather than almost every time I try.) Apart from this one _tiny_ issue, this is a very well made and useful mod. 

Thanks for all the blood, sweat and tears you've put into JEI, it's a wonderful mod!
  -Kd

(By the way, I'm going to bed after I write this, so I won't be able to reply to anything until tomorrow, sorry...)

issues.title: Search Bar and JEI Config button are broken
issues.body:
When hovering over the JEI Config wrench button it lights up blue, so it can see my mouse. However, clicking on it results in no action. The same happens with the paging arrows in the upper right. The search bar cannot search items either.

Modlist: http://sprunge.us/Tijb
I'm using Forge 2201 on Minecraft 1.11.2. I'm running my custom modpack in MultiMC on Arch GNU/Linux. Let me know if you need any more info.

edit: the ctrl-f binding also wasn't working, but it seems to have been conflicting with my inventory binding being f. I changed the bind to ctrl-e and I can now get to the search bar that way to search, but clicking still doesn't work. I also can't view recipes of items by clicking on them after searching.

edit2: When disabling all mods aside from JEI, I do not have the issue. I will continue troubleshooting.

edit3: Well, that didn't take long. FOV Zoom is what broke it. I'll see if I can report to them next. Feel free to close this if you think it's all on their end.

issues.title: Search Bar suggestion
issues.body:
Possibly disable the look up recipe/use functions (default 'r' & 'u' keys) when typing in search bar? If the mouse is hovering over an item in the inventory or the item panel and one of those is pressed jei pulls you out of search and into recipe view.

Thanks I love the mod though 🥇

issues.title: Hiding items issue
issues.body:
Hiding items in JEI is nice, but when I go to hiding items, anything that has a tag on the end and using the same base ID it hides all of them. For example <agricraft:water_channel_full>.withTag({agri_material_meta: 13, agri_material: "forestry:planks.0"})
<agricraft:water_channel_full>.withTag({agri_material_meta: 9, agri_material: "forestry:planks.fireproof.0"})
I would like to hide each individual one of these from within the mod instead of all of them at once.

issues.title: "Fast" item rendering in item list skips RenderItem#renderItemAndEffectIntoGUI
issues.body:
"Fast" item rendering directly gets IBakedModel and renders it. When really faster than default rendering, hooks like CodeChickenLib IItemRenderer don't get called, resulting non-hovered and fast-rendered items  invisibility.

Possible solutions:
* Add item blacklist for fast rendering.

issues.body: Hopefully this wouldn't require a coremod to do, but it's something that I think would be interesting for a few mod ideas I have kicking around that would only show certain items in JEI if they have a certain thing enabled (basically opt-in silliness, since I know some people don't like to even see it in the game). If hiding recipes isn't possible, then maybe allow the showing of an alternate screen (something like "you need X before you can learn about this") would be cool.

issues.title: IRecipeLayout#setRecipeTransferButton() doesn't seem to do anything
issues.body:
JEI version: 3.13.6.387 for MC 1.10.2

I've created a JEI plugin to wrap a couple of custom (simple shaped workbench crafting) recipes in my mod, and generally it's working very well.  One minor issue, though: the "Move Items" button is wedged in the bottom right corner of the drawable panel, and no combination of co-ordinates to ``IRecipeLayout#setRecipeTransferButton()`` seems to move it.  Not a huge deal, since the button works fine, but definitely a cosmetic annoyance - I'd like the button to be near the output slot, similar to vanilla crafting recipes.

Code is here: https://github.com/desht/ModularRouters/blob/master/src/main/java/me/desht/modularrouters/integration/jei/ModuleEnhancementRecipeCategory.java#L72

Example of what it looks like right now: http://imgur.com/a/8JE7x

Am I doing something really dumb here, or is there an actual issue?

issues.body:
I'm using JEI JEI@3.13.6.387.  Forge 12.18.2.2151, MC 1.10.2

issues.title: Exact searching
issues.body:
It would be great to have exact searching instead of searching for each word individually. I quite liked the way NEI handled this, using exact matching by default and supporting or via |.

Alternatively one could introduce opt-in exact searching using "", for example to search for "Fertility: 4" as currently one would need to look through every search result to find what *actually* has Fertility 4 and not just Fertility or 4.

Thanks for your time to look at this suggestion and making this great mod!

issues.title: Search bar; loss of focus / hang
issues.body:
This event is kind of frustrating as I'm having difficulty reproducing it in a reliable manner. However, it affects both myself and others using the mod-pack. Here goes:

After having typed something into JEI and wishing to erase it, some unknown event triggers (presumably a bad mod interaction?), and the search bar stops responding. The search box no longer takes input from the keyboard or mouse, and I have to close and re-open my inventory before it will take inputs again. If I right-click the search bar before triggering the event, it clears the entire bar, but then the event triggers and it stops taking input, requiring inventory window refresh.

Things I know about the issue:
- It stops deleting text at the last, or second to last, character. (e.g. "banana" stops at "ba" or "b")
- I have to refresh my inventory window before I can finish deleting the text, and type my new query.
- Right-click to clear will delete the entire bar, but it still won't allow input until after inventory refresh.
- Once the issue occurs, text cannot be added either. It is stuck.
- The error can occur in both single and multiplayer!

Things I'm presuming:
- Is caused by bad mod interaction with JEI, ~though I'm currently unsure which mod~ [SignPicture](https://minecraft.curseforge.com/projects/sign-picture).
- The issue seems to trigger after a set amount of time? Or possibly when exploring item recipes in JEI?

Things I've tried / am trying:
- ~Right-click to clear; causes error to trigger.~
- ~If I quickly type and delete text, the issue doesn't seem to occur (at least not yet)~.
- Seems to occur when hitting certain keys while searching in JEI.

General Info:
- MC version: 1.10.2
- Forge version: forge-12.18.3.2185
- Has occurred in two different mod packs I've modified. One is the Direwolf pack, the other is the "All The Mods" pack. (However, I feel it important to note that I have **_heavily_** edited both mod packs. At the point the error occurred, they were more or less home-brew packs.)

Will update this as I gain a better understanding.

issues.title: [1.11] JEI not working after Ore Dictionary nullability fixes
issues.body:
MinecraftForge/MinecraftForge@bf090cb4c2f76dc4bd6f58f7cbcb6b3487407dae fixed the `ItemStack` nullability issues with the Ore Dictionary.

This means that `IRecipe#getRecipeOutput` always returns a non-`null` value for ore recipes and `ShapelessOreRecipe#getInput` returns a `NonNullList` instead of an `ArrayList`.

issues.title: Add a way to add ItemStacks to JEI during runtime
issues.body: Some mods need to do some synchronization to send custom item configurations from the server to the client during the first tick after a player joined. These items do not appear in JEI by default as it has already loaded by then. I'd like to see a way to add ItemStacks to JEI after it has loaded, i.e. at any point in time (using `IJeiRuntime` or `IItemListOverlay`). One issue is how to handle loading recipes for these items as that would have to occur during runtime as well (maybe a new `IItemRegistry` containing only the new item(s)?).

issues.title: IGuiIngredientGroup should have a few simpler init methods
issues.body:
The default init method is this:
```Java
	void init(int slotIndex, boolean input,
			  IIngredientRenderer<T> ingredientRenderer,
			  int xPosition, int yPosition,
			  int width, int height,
			  int xPadding, int yPadding);
```

when registering an Ingredient, you already have to hand in a default IIngredientRenderer, so there should be an option to render from that instead.  Also, the IGuiItemStackGroup has a simple init method of this:

```Java
	void init(int slotIndex, boolean input, int xPosition, int yPosition);
```
which could probably be used for IGuiIngredientGroup  as well, by putting default values for the width, height, paddings and renderer.

issues.title: Item List will not re-render when pressing hotkey for visibility of JEI
issues.body:
In the latest release of JEI, if you press your hotkey to hide JEI, it hides properly. When you press the hotkey to show it again, it will not render until you enter another GUI Screen. This does not match behaviour of previous versions and doesn't appear to be marked as a feature change so I am opening this bug report.

To reproduce, just hide the GUI using your hotkey and try to toggle it.

I tested this without any other mods using forge-1.10.2-12.18.2.2118 and jei_1.10.2-3.13.2.357.

issues.title: [Feature][API] Add ordering of custom categories
issues.body:
It would be useful to be able to code in the order of custom categories added.

For example, in Iron Backpacks, I would ideally want to first show the player the 'Description' section when they pressed 'u', and then they could press the right arrow to go to the recipe to upgrade a backpack, then the recipe to add an upgrade, and lastly the recipe to remove an upgrade. This strict ordering would make things more clear to the player, and adds a lot of flexibility on the end of mod developers as well. 

Additionally, it would be nice to be able to configure it for both 'show recipes and 'usages' (i.e. 'r' and 'u'), as the two are not always synonymous. Going off the same example above, it would be ideal if when 'r' was pressed, the recipe to make the backpack popped up first, then the description, followed by the recipe to add an upgrade and then finally by the recipe to remove an upgrade.

#### Pictures
Right now this is how it works with 'r' click (picture 1 -> right arrow -> picture 2):
![2016-11-03_09 18 45](https://cloud.githubusercontent.com/assets/6507574/19974703/9880c26c-a1a6-11e6-9485-7281e23e63c0.png) 
![2016-11-03_09 18 52](https://cloud.githubusercontent.com/assets/6507574/19974719/a76c1eca-a1a6-11e6-947a-109ce9af5d88.png)

And I would like to make it so that the description category is always shown second, after the first right click from the crafting category (instead of the 4th as it currently is):
![2016-11-03_09 18 56](https://cloud.githubusercontent.com/assets/6507574/19974772/d9bddb84-a1a6-11e6-9932-1b19e6286b15.png)

issues.body:
I just recently did the JEI Plugin for IC2Classic... And it was easier & harder then i through.
Good work mate. Its way more modular now. And the caching of recipes is a good idea.
But 1 feature is sadly not really possible with JEI which i kinda wish that would be possible.
The option that you could hide Recipe Entries. Without forcing the player to reload resource locations when they unhide them. (Not via JEI more via the mod who adds them)
I made a semi hidden recipe at the moment where i just show the output and not the input but i am not really happy about that idea.
So a question? Is it possible to hide recipes without making them invalid?

issues.title: Search bar is invisible
issues.body:
Thank you for reporting!
- If you crashed, please paste the crash log to [gist](https://gist.github.com/) and link it here.
- Please do not suggest features from NEI. [See this spreadsheet](https://goo.gl/MQ0f3R).
- Try the latest version, it may have fixed the issue already.
- If you have FEI installed, please try without it before reporting.

issues.title: Keybinding to jump to the search box
issues.body: In the old NEI, one used to be able to press '**F**' to jump directly to the search box. This would be a very useful feature to bring into JEI.

issues.title: [Suggestion] Save searches
issues.body:
As a feature suggestion it might be cool to be able to save searches for later quick reference. The saved searches could appear as buttons on the left side of the inventory screen and when clicked would automatically apply the text into the search box.

If implemented, future releases may add the ability to group and reorder the saved searches.

issues.title: Cannot ctrl-click on OS X
issues.body:
Hello

I am trying to hide an item in JEI, so I went to the config menu and enabled "Item Hiding Mode". When I hover the item I want to hide, I can see "Ctrl-click to hide" in the tooltip.
However I am using an Apple computer, and ctrl-click is mapped system-wide to right-click. So when I try to ctrl-click, JEI just shows the uses of that item (normal right-click behavior) and doesn't hide it.
Is there a way to use something else than ctrl-click for OS X?

Also, manually editing the itemBlacklist.cfg in the config folder works, this is just a suggestion for convenience.

Thank you for your work

(sorry for my bad english)

issues.title: Cheat mode give bypasses CommandEvent
issues.body:
The way forge does CommandEvent, only has them sent after icommand.checkPermission(server, sender)
has returned true.  This means that to make a Permissions mod without coremod hackery, requires making that method always return true, by settings PlayerList.commandsAllowedForAll to true.

The problem then comes from when JEI checks icommand.checkPermission(server, sender), and gives the item if it is true, without sending a CommandEvent, and checking if that is canceled.  This will result in any player being able to use the cheat mode, even if a permissions mod would prevent it via cancelling CommandEvent.

See Thutmose/Thut#14 for where it was reported to me, or MinecraftModDevelopment/MMD-Dev-Server#193 for where it was discovered.

At some point I might get around to reporting this to minecraft forge itself, but I am not sure if I currently have time to get around to trying to make a PR for them.

issues.title: Recipe Rendering via the API
issues.body:
What im going to suggest here is a way to lookup all recipes (or usages) for a given stack via the API and a way to render those recipes in a gui. 

**# My Current Implementation**

Example: https://puu.sh/rixGR/232051afbf.png 

In that example i am accessing JEI directly in order to create an instance of RecipeLayout for each recipe. I am then wrapping those recipe layouts with my own IRecipeRenderer interface in order to make them safe for use outside of my helper class.  The code i use can be seen here.

Helper http://pastebin.com/w3HYugE9
Wrapper http://pastebin.com/H3VKcDy0

The result is i can simple (and safely) call JeiHelper.getRecipeRenderers(ItemStack result) and i get a list of IRecipeRenderer's that can then be rendered in a GUI.

**#How JEI could do it**

To get this same functionality in JEI would only require a couple changes to the API.

IRecipeLayout would need a draw method matching RecipeLayout.draw
and a getFocusUnderMouse method would also be useful for detecting clicks on ingredients.

Another thing that may be useful is a way to reposition an IRecipeLayout because in my particular use case the gui has scrolling functionality meaning the recipe display needs to be able to move. The only way i was able to do this was to create a new instance of RecipeLayout whenever the recipe position needed to change.

The other change you would need to make is a way to get the IRecipeLayout's for a given ItemStack or FluidStack. 
I dont know enough about JEI's back end to be able to make any good suggestions for this but perhaps this could be done but i imagine the best way to make it available through the API would be with ether IJeiHelpers or IJeiRuntime.

These methods would be something like getRecipeLauouts ans getUsageLayouts both of which would return all IRecipeLayout's for a given stack / fluid stack but of course one would return the recipes for the item and the other would return recipes using the item.

Not sure how you would handle categories. Perhaps you could return a Map<IRecipeCategory, IRecipeLayout>
Or just add a getCategory method to IRecipeLayout and let the user sort them out.

It would also be helpful to have a way to check the witch and height if a recipe. a getCategory method in IRecipeLayout would also help with that because from there you could use getBackground().getWidth() and getHeight()

Im sure there are a lot of other usefull things that could be added but i think i have covered the essentials.... Sorry about the terribly long issue...

issues.title: API Filtering Paging Bug
issues.body:
Using refined storage (RS), there is an option to synchronize the search within RS with JEI.  When searching JEI through RS it is possible to be on a page that does not exist.  For example you could easily end up on page 40 of 4.  As expected, no items will be displayed.  RS is using the api method `IItemListOverlay#setFilterText` to cause the search.  When this method is called JEI should reset the paging such that page 1 is the current page.  Implementing this change will cause JEI's behavior to be consistent between searching through the API and while searching in the default JEI search box.  

For more information please refer to https://github.com/raoulvdberge/refinedstorage/issues/166

issues.title: PC locks up for a few seconds when first opening inventory.
issues.body:
FEI is not installed but it could be some mod causing the issue. There isn't a crash it just clocks up Minecraft for a bit. My gaming computer locks up for 1-2 seconds while my slower work PC locks up for 8 seconds. This happens to everyone running my pack ["All the Mods"](http://minecraft.curseforge.com/projects/all-the-mods). 

After the first lockup it works fine the rest of the time.

issues.title: Add support for Creative Inventory Action as an alternative to /give
issues.body: Using [Creative Inventory Action](http://wiki.vg/Protocol#Creative_Inventory_Action) JEI could spawn in items for players in creative, even on vanilla servers, as players in Creative can summon any item at will from the server. There's a blacklist, but it's rather small.

issues.title: When seeing what items come from the ground while holding the alt key caused my game to crash
issues.body:
Thank you for reporting!

When reporting:
- If you use ForeverEnoughItems, please remove it and try again or [report here instead](https://github.com/elix-x/Forever-Enough-Items/issues).  
- Please do not suggest features from NEI. [NotEnoughWidgets will have those features.](https://github.com/TheCBProject/NotEnoughItems/issues/6)
- Try the [latest version](http://minecraft.curseforge.com/projects/just-enough-items-jei/files), it may have fixed the issue already.
- If you crashed, please paste the crash log to https://gist.github.com/ and link it here.

Minecraft Version used: 1.9.4
Recent Version of JEI: (1.9.4) 3.6.7.216
Forge version: 12.0.17.1987
Crash Log: http://pastebin.com/BLb7ScGW

I'm not exactly sure your mod is the culprit but I was looking at the ground and hitting the alt key. Doing that showed me what seeds/items I could harvest from the ground. While doing so I looked at grass and the game froze up and crashed. I'll have a look at what other mod could have caused that (such as an addon to your mod if your's wasn't the culprit)

issues.title: SubtypeRegistry cannot be used for damageable items
issues.body: It is only used for items that getHasSubtypes(), so it doesn't work for swords and other damageable items that can have NBT (e.g. the upgradable Ender IO tools).

issues.title: Error with Integration
issues.body:
Hey,
I've added integration for JEI perfectly in 1.8.9, I found that when I ported to 1.9.4 some of my addRecipeClickArea methods didn't work. I've narrowed this down now, it seems that only GUI classes which extends GuiContainer directly work. Ones which extend another class in the hierarchy don't work.

Thank you for a great mod
Ollie

Hello, I'm testing The Pioneers R.8 on a server. Some of the item's won't show the crafting recipe when I click on them. Neotech has quite a few blocks that I can't see. 

If I create a new world in single player it's working correctly. Any ideas as to how to troubleshoot this? I've reinstalled the pack several times and the server admin says he's not seeing any issues being logged. 

Thanks for any assistance!

issues.title: Expose registered recipe transfer handlers through API
issues.body:
As the title suggests, this is a proposal to add some way of accessing registered recipe transfer handlers without needing to link to internal code. Currently, one may get ahold of a handler through `Internal.getRuntime().getRecipeRegistry().getRecipeTransferHandler`. However, this is suboptimal due to the need to access internals which may change on the whims of the author without warning.

This might be especially useful if somebody is implementing their own custom transfer handler which only enhances the functionality of another one or reuses its data, like in my particular [use case](https://github.com/PaleoCrafter/VanillaImmersion/blob/master/src/main/kotlin/de/mineformers/vanillaimmersion/integration/jei/plugin.kt#L54). Rather than referring to internals, using reflection or even copying code, a universal way of acquiring another handler through the API would be the best way of dealing with this situation.

issues.title: 1.9 JEI possibly getting overloaded causing GC sweep lag spikes.
issues.body:
I am not quite sure where to go with this as there possibly could be many mods involved. I am making my own personal 1.9 modpack and I came across an issue after I installed Botania. After installing it I am getting ~1-2 second lag spikes with every GC round that was happening every 3-4 seconds. I have 1.5G allocated to MC, but the GC sweeps are happening at 1.3G and taking it down to 1G repeatedly, not even allocating the full 1.5G. 

Removing JEI resolves this issue, or removing either botania, or a few other mods, will also stop the issue from happening. The determining factor seems to be just the pure number of recipes, as I can't find any combination of mods that cause the issue individually, or as a group of 5-10, just as a whole group of mods approaching 50.

I enabled verbose GC and this is the log that resulted: https://gist.github.com/NolanSyKinsley/a868fe08be23bfcf0c4c03f4766252ab

(yes, I have also tested without optifine, same issue, I have also tried adding mods one by one looking for the culprit and never been able to find the smoking gun)

If there is anything I can do to get to the root cause of the issue please let me know.

issues.title: Bug with spawning in items with NBTDouble/Float.
issues.body:
Ok, so there is a bug when you spawn in an Item, that has a NBT on it.
For example when you have an item in JEI, that (for whatever reason has a nbt tag "someNumber" = 10,000,000D on it (A NBTTagDouble with 10 Million), and you spawn that item in in JEI, it does not have that NBTTag on it anymore. Instead, the NBTTagCompound of the ItemStack has a NBTTagString with 1.0E7d on it. This is due to the NBTTagCompound.toString() converting the Double into something, the Minecraft Give Command does not parse as a Double.
The issue lies here: https://github.com/mezz/JustEnoughItems/blob/8b318360cacf21db602855fb2933c07aa030eff2/src/main/java/mezz/jei/util/Commands.java#L46
I suggest using another way to convert the NBTTagCompount of an ItemStack to a String.

issues.title: Transitive Crafting
issues.body:
Hey there,
what do you think about adding a transitive crafting function? E.g. transitively crafting a crafting table from a wood log. Implementation would be tricky, but possible (disclaimer: I did not look at the JEI code at all yet).

Some stuff to consider off the top of my head:
- Handle unused itermediate products (e.g. transitively crafting a torch with a coal and log would result in 4 torches, 3 sticks and  2 planks).
- Whether to do partial crafting if not everything is in the inventory (e.g. trying to craft a torch from only a log, should this still create 4 sticks and 2 planks, or just leave the log unchanged?)
- Handle multiple possibilities to craft (e.g. crafting a torch from coal, an oak log and a birch log)
- How to handle crafting that comes at a cost (resources or time), or which does not completely happen in a GUI - make transitive crafting opt-in via the plugin api?

And finally, does this even belong in a utility mod (gameplay-wise), or should this functionality be tied to setup or costs (as in e.g. Applied Energistics or Logistics Pipes)?

issues.title: Recipes on meta and nbt sensitive items.
issues.body:
I am not entirely sure how to explain this issue, as it is a bit tricky to narrow down. The primary issue is that recipes are being grouped together based on meta and nbt, when they probably shouldn't be. Here are a few examples of what I mean. 

If you have 1 item with 5 meta states, and give each a unique description recipe, they would only show their own description, however if you were to then add a generic description to that item without specifying a meta value, it would group all 5 description recipes, plus the one generic recipe together. 

In Botania, if you look up the recipe for any flower, it starts you off with the pure daisy recipe, regardless of where you started in the list. 

If you were to add a description to a ItemStack with an nbt value such as an enchanted book, the description will show the correct enchanted ItemStack, however when you add more, it won't display the correct discreption based on the item you clicked on, and it will start you off with the first one registered.

issues.title: API Request: A way to provide dynamic recipes based on item being searched for

milestone.title: Advanced Recipe Support
milestone.description: JEI needs some key features to become more flexible and support complex recipes more easily.

issues.body:
Maybe i'm missing something but it looks like currently all recipes need to be registered with actual itemstacks on startup.

There are many things that are not feasible to create a recipe instance for every possible variation because it would either spam the user with repetitive information or simply not possible due to combinatorial explosion of variations (e.g. genetic template + sample recipes in Gendustry would probably take more space than the observable universe).

My suggestion would be to have some kind of recipe provider interface that mods can register, and will provide getRecipeCategoriesWithInput/Output and getRecipesWithInput/Output implementations that generate recipes based on the queried item at runtime. 

RecipeRegistry will call those providers when it's queried and merge any recipes they return with the static list it gets from RecipeMap.

issues.title: API Additions
issues.body:
I've been working on an addon for JEI (2.16.2.78) and I've had a few issues with interacting with the mod. I'll list them here. I might add more later as I encounter them. If there is a direct or better way to do any of these, please let me know.
- [ ]  Add a way to retrieve the RecipesGui instance. Currently I'm reflecting `guiEventHandler` from `ProxyCommonClient` (gotten from the `JustEnoughItems` instance) and then reflecting that to get `recipesGui`. I would appreciate if a way was added. (Not necessarily in the API. Mods that are simply adding their recipes will probably not need to access the GUI instance.)
- [ ] Add a way to get `logic` from `RecipesGui`, currently using reflection. (Not necessarily in the API.)
- [ ] Add a way to set the specific page (by index) and category (by instance & index) in `IRecipeGuiLogic`. Currently using (a lot of) reflection.
- [x] The experience gained text in the furnace recipe gui extends past the width specified by the background. This causes the text to sometimes continue past the specified area for the recipe. Not entirely sure what can be done about this, maybe a way to move the text left if needed?

Another more general point - A lot of classes that I could foresee extending have all private fields. It would be useful if the classes that are likely to be extended have protected fields.

If you are in the creative inventory and typing in the search box with your mouse over an item, typing the key U or R will consume that key press and open up the recipe/usage gui if one exists.

An easy way to test this is to type the word quartz in the search bar.

issues.title: Item hover overlay is being rendered behind the items.
issues.body: In normal GUIs, the light-grey overlay that appears when hovering over an item appears in front of an item, but in JEI it is rendered behind the item. I don't really care if this is changed or not, but it's something I noticed.

issues.title: Fullscreen mode
issues.body:
If you're ever super bored and have nothing to do, make JEI uber mode. Basically it would make JEI fill up every available blank spot around a GUI.

This is half joke, half serious. Perhaps there could be a hotkey for like a "fullscreen" mode or something? It would make an overlay on top of anything (like the thaumonomicon sorta) that is just pure JEI.

issues.title: Extra Utilities has a super super handy function, that would be great for this
issues.body:
When you play vanilla, or any mod pack without a centralized storage system (AKA needing hundreds of chests) it allows you to press T while hovering over an item in 'nei' or in this case, would be JEI, or your inventory, or another chest, it would highlight any chests within a chunk distance away (I believe it calculates the chunk your in, extends out a chunk, enclosing a 3x3 chunk area probably by 10 up/down) that contain the item. This highlight it just a bunch of smoke particles over the chest that contains the item. These particles can be seen through the ground/walls etc.

I think having this as a default feature could be handy, and would be a nice addition to singleplayer and even multiplayer (when forge fixes their stuff). :)

issues.title: The use of wrapper classes is an issue...
issues.body:
So I'm noticing that your way of providing implementation is through specific wrapper classes that appear to have to be done before-hand for each and every GUI. This makes interacting with mods basically impossible. Not only that, but reflection can _potentially_ cause some performance impacts.

While I understand you want JEI to be simple and light, the use of ASM to cooperate with all GuiContainer implementations seems like the better route.
